## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und dir gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits und mehr Infos zum Berufsbild findest du hier.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführerin oder Lokführer Bauzüge leistest du einen grossen Beitrag, um die Erneuerungen der Trassen (Gleise, Schotter usw.) sicherzustellen.
- Du leistest und führst verschiedene und komplexe Rangierbewegungen von Zügen bis zu maximal 100 km/h selbständig, formierst und zerlegst diese und bereitest sie für die Fahrt vor.
- Um die regionale Logistik sicherzustellen, entwirfst, beantragst und bestellst du Fahrordnungen termingerecht und verantwortest die Versorgung von Baustellen mit den erforderlichen Materialien.
- Du hast eine hohe Verantwortung in der Betriebssicherheit der Bauzüge. Das Prüfen der Arbeitsstellensicherheit sowie Erstellen von Rapporten runden die Tätigkeiten ab.
- Zusätzlich wirst du als Lokführerinnen und Lokführer Bauzüge auf der Baustelle eingesetzt und dein handwerkliches Geschick wird gefordert.
Das bringst du mit.
- Es gefällt dir, sowohl im Team zu arbeiten als auch Aufgaben selbstständig zu erledigen. Du bist zuverlässig und zeichnest dich durch die hohe Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag aus.
- Unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten inklusive Nacht- und Wochenendarbeit gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du bist körperlich fit und hast Freude an der Arbeit im Freien.
- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Triebfahrzeugführer:in VTE Kategorie B100 und hast praktische Erfahrungen als Lokführer:in von Bauzügen gesammelt.
- Du zeichnest dich durch ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein aus und behältst auch in schwierigen sowie hektischen Situationen Ruhe und Übersicht.
- Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C1) in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung.
- Du besitzt den Führerausweis Kategorie B.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau F, Regionalzulage Stufe 0. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

A FFS, hai la possibilità di contribuire alle tue competenze e allo stesso tempo acquisire nuove competenze che arricchiscono e avanzano professionalmente. Si vede ore di lavoro irregolari e lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per godersi il vostro tempo libero mentre altri lavorano. Il lavoro notturno e fine settimana viene pagato anche per, ad esempio, un supplemento di salario orario di 16 franchi per il lavoro di domenica. Per le assegnazioni notturne, si ottiene supplementi di tempo del 10 al 30%, che consente più tempo libero. Vantaggi come GA gratuito, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - possono essere trovati sul nostro sito web sotto Vantaggi e ulteriori informazioni sul profilo del lavoro possono essere trovati qui. Puoi spostarlo. - Come autista del treno o autista del treno per i treni da costruzione, si contribuisce in modo significativo al rinnovo delle rotte (acciaio, ghiaia, ecc.). - Lei effettua in modo indipendente ed esegue vari e complessi movimenti di manovra di treni fino ad un massimo di 100 km/h, li forma e li smonta e li prepara per il viaggio. - Al fine di garantire la logistica regionale, progetta, applica e ordina le norme di guida in tempo e sono responsabili per la fornitura di siti di costruzione con i materiali necessari. - Ha un'alta responsabilità nella sicurezza operativa dei treni di costruzione. Controllare la sicurezza del lavoro e creare report completano le attività. - Inoltre, sarete utilizzati come autista del treno sul cantiere e la vostra maestria sarà richiesta. Lo porti con te. - Ti piace lavorare in una squadra e fare compiti indipendentemente. Sei affidabile e caratterizzato dall'elevata flessibilità nel lavoro quotidiano. Ore lavorative irregolari, tra cui il lavoro notturno e il fine settimana, fanno parte del vostro lavoro quotidiano. Siete fisicamente in forma e godere di lavorare all'aperto. - Hai completato la formazione come autista del treno: nella categoria VTE B100 e hai acquisito esperienza pratica come autista del treno: nei treni di costruzione. - Sei caratterizzato da una forte consapevolezza della sicurezza e mantieni la calma e la panoramica anche in situazioni difficili e frenetiche. La conoscenza fluente del tedesco (livello C1) in parola e scrittura è un prerequisito. - Ha la patente di guida categoria B. ## I tuoi salari e benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale equo e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente alla parità di retribuzione. Pertanto, ulteriori e dettagliate informazioni sul sistema salariale sono visibili in modo trasparente alle FFS. Questo posto è a livello di requisito F, livello di indennità regionale 0. Train driver: in construction trains Cat. B100 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Train driver: in construction trains Cat. B100 Red Cross and Lucerne, 01.07.2026 or by arrangement, 60-100 % Apply now ## You can look forward to that. At SBB, you have the chance to contribute your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that enrich and advance you professionally. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage to enjoy your free time while others work. Night and weekend work is also paid for, for example, an hourly wage supplement of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night assignments, you get time surcharges of 10 to 30%, which allows you more free time. Benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - can be found on our website under Benefits and more information about the job profile can be found here. You can move that. - As a train driver or train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (steel, gravel, etc.). - You independently perform and perform various and complex maneuvering movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you design, apply for and order driving regulations on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high responsibility in the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking job security and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be used as a train driver on the construction site and your craftsmanship will be required. You bring that with you. - You like both working in a team and doing tasks independently. You are reliable and characterized by the high flexibility in everyday work. Irregular working hours including night and weekend work are part of your daily work. You are physically fit and enjoy working outdoors. - You have completed training as a train driver: in VTE category B100 and have gained practical experience as a train driver:in construction trains. - You are characterized by a strong awareness of security and keep calm and overview even in difficult and hectic situations. Flowing knowledge of German (level C1) in word and writing is a prerequisite. - You have the driving licence category B. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This post is at requirement level F, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. This starts with your application. ## Continue like this. × At the latest 10 working days after receipt of the application, you will receive an initial feedback from us. Final decision up to one month after receiving the application Application Final decision up to one month after receiving the application Still questions? The application process SBB Recruitment Support Phone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #SimplyYou FAQ for Application For the purpose of Job ID 103565 Luca of wood Phone +41 79 363 34 15 Applications by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered. For this position, we do not accept dossiers from recruiters. ##
• We offer that. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we focus on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to reconciling your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We promote our employees according to their personal needs and ambitions. For this purpose, we provide a broad range of interdisciplinary and cross-divisional training offers. In selected external training, we participate financially and temporally. Train driver: in construction trains Cat. B100 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Train driver: in construction trains Cat. B100 Winterthur and Zurich, 01.09.2026 or by arrangement, 60-100 % Apply now ## You can look forward to that. At SBB, you have the chance to contribute your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that enrich and advance you professionally. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage to enjoy your free time while others work. Night and weekend work is also paid for, for example, an hourly wage supplement of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night assignments, you get time surcharges of 10 to 30%, which allows you more free time. Benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - can be found on our website under Benefits and more information about the job profile can be found here. You can move that. - As a train driver or train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (steel, gravel, etc.). - You independently perform and perform various and complex maneuvering movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you design, apply for and order driving regulations on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high responsibility in the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking job security and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be used as a train driver on the construction site and your craftsmanship will be required. You bring that with you. - You like both working in a team and doing tasks independently. You are reliable and characterized by the high flexibility in everyday work. Irregular working hours including night and weekend work are part of your daily work. You are physically fit and enjoy working outdoors. - You have completed training as a train driver: in VTE category B100 and have gained practical experience as a train driver:in construction trains. - You are characterized by a strong awareness of security and keep calm and overview even in difficult and hectic situations. Flowing knowledge of German (level C1) in word and writing is a prerequisite. - You have the driving licence category B. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This job is in requirement level F, Regional Allowance Level 2. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. This starts with your application. ## Continue like this. × At the latest 10 working days after receipt of the application, you will receive an initial feedback from us. For this position, we do not accept dossiers from recruiters. ##

Sei un elettricista con cuore e anima e sei pronto per un lavoro interessante in un team motivato e amichevole nel settore dei sistemi di sicurezza? Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo in cui potrete guidare grandi cambiamenti e contribuire così alla digitalizzazione delle FFS. Insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, svilupperai soluzioni alle sfide attuali e le implementerai come una squadra. Anche la formazione continua non viene trascurata per lo sviluppo professionale individuale. Per noi sono molto importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti. I nostri vantaggi come assegni per figli, AG gratuita in 2a classe e viaggi all'estero scontati - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - Ti occupi dei lavori di costruzione, manutenzione e riparazione dei sistemi infrastrutturali e quindi fornisci un contributo importante al regolare traffico ferroviario. - Ti aspetta una vita lavorativa varia e diversificata, principalmente turni giornalieri in diverse stazioni FFS dell'Alto Vallese. - Garantite lo smantellamento e la messa in servizio di vari sistemi di sicurezza, dai sistemi di interblocco elettronici agli interblocchi a relè. - Attraverso il vostro approccio sistematico riconoscete e segnalate irregolarità e difetti e avviate la loro eliminazione e ulteriore sviluppo. - Completa due anni di formazione interna per diventare un tecnico dei sistemi di sicurezza. Qui sarai formato per individuare e risolvere autonomamente i guasti nei sistemi interni. - Con le conoscenze e l'esperienza specialistica appena apprese, individuerai e riparerai autonomamente i guasti nei sistemi di sicurezza nel servizio di picchetto. Questo è quello che porti con te. - La sicurezza è la tua massima priorità. descriptionByLocale.en: Electrical installer: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Electrical installer: in Brig, July 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Are you an electrician with heart and soul and are you ready for an interesting job in a motivated and friendly team in the area of ​​security systems? An innovative working environment awaits you in which you can drive big changes and thus contribute to the digitalization of SBB. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for individual professional development. Attractive working conditions are very important to us. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - You take care of the construction, maintenance and repair work of infrastructure systems and thus make an important contribution to smooth rail traffic. - A varied and diverse working life awaits you, mainly day shifts at various SBB train stations in the Upper Valais region. - You ensure the dismantling and commissioning of various security systems - from electronic interlocking systems to relay interlockings. - Through your systematic approach, you recognize and report irregularities and defects and initiate their elimination and further development. - You complete two years of internal training to become a security systems technician. Here you will be trained to independently locate and resolve faults in the indoor systems. - With your newly learned specialist knowledge and experience, you will independently locate and repair faults in the security systems in the on-call service. This is what you bring with you. - Safety is your top priority. To ensure this, we require unrestricted hearing and vision in order to be able to recognize important acoustic and visual signals during operations in the track area. - You get involved in our organization as well as in the team and take on responsibility. - You find working indoors and in the track area exciting. - You have completed four years of basic training as an electrical installer EFZ. - You don't mind occasional irregular work or on-call duty at night and on weekends. - You have a Category B driving license as well as good oral and written knowledge of German (at least B2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103093 Josef Eyer, team leader Telephone +41 79 223 00 87 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Êtes-vous un électricien de cœur et d'âme et êtes-vous prêt pour un travail intéressant au sein d'une équipe motivée et conviviale dans le domaine des systèmes de sécurité ? Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend dans lequel vous pourrez conduire de grands changements et ainsi contribuer à la numérisation des CFF. Avec vos coéquipiers, vous développerez des solutions aux défis actuels et les mettrez en œuvre en équipe. La formation continue n’est pas non plus négligée pour le développement professionnel individuel. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont très importantes pour nous. Vous trouverez nos avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous vous occupez des travaux de construction, d'entretien et de réparation des systèmes d'infrastructure et apportez ainsi une contribution importante au bon fonctionnement du trafic ferroviaire. - Une vie professionnelle variée et diversifiée vous attend, principalement des équipes de jour dans les différentes gares CFF du Haut-Valais. - Vous assurez le démontage et la mise en service de différents systèmes de sécurité - des systèmes de verrouillage électroniques aux verrouillages à relais. - Grâce à votre approche systématique, vous reconnaissez et signalez les irrégularités et les défauts et initiez leur élimination et leur développement ultérieur. - Vous suivez une formation interne de deux ans pour devenir technicien en systèmes de sécurité. Ici, vous serez formé pour localiser et résoudre de manière indépendante les défauts des systèmes intérieurs. - Grâce à vos connaissances spécialisées et à votre expérience nouvellement acquises, vous localisez et réparez de manière indépendante les défauts des systèmes de sécurité au sein du service d'astreinte. Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Quereinstieg Zugverkehrsleiter:in
Zürich Flughafen oder Rangierbahnhof Limmattal, nach Vereinbarung, 100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst und überwachst die Züge an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit rund acht Bildschirmen. Im Normalbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr, steuerst die Abläufe und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. Damit trägst du die Mitverantwortung für die Mobilität der Schweiz. Ohne dich steht das Netz still. Der Job ist systemrelevant und unmittelbar wirkungsvoll: Du koordinierst Mensch und Technik, triffst rasche Entscheidungen und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs.
Wir bieten dir eine bezahlte Zweitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin oder zum Zugverkehrsleiter, die acht Monate dauert. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung bist du in der Betriebszentrale in Zürich Flughafen oder im Rangierbahnhof Limmattal tätig und hilfst dabei, dass 9000 Personen- und 2000 Güterzüge täglich sicher und pünktlich ihr Ziel erreichen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Infoveranstaltung .
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Sonntagsarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland – auch für die Familie – findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.
Möglicher Starttermin:
- 1. März 2027
- 1. Juli 2027
- 1. November 2027
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst Züge sicher und ökologisch und überwachst den Verkehr.
- Im Regelbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr; bei Störungen handelst du ruhig und effizient, leitest sofort Massnahmen ein und stellst den Normalbetrieb wieder her.
- Bei Störungen leitest du Massnahmen ein, damit der Normalzustand wiederhergestellt wird.
- Du koordinierst und kommunizierst mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokpersonal sowie Bau- und Rangierpersonal.
- Du verantwortest die Kundeninformation an Bahnhöfen und sorgst für klare, zeitnahe Mitteilungen.
- Dank deinem Einsatz sind Personen- und Güterzüge rund um die Uhr sicher und pünktlich unterwegs.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne im Team und bist bereit, im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du denkst strukturiert und vernetzt. In Stresssituationen handelst du schnell und überlegt. Die technische Affinität wird in der Ausbildung gefördert.
- Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Lernbereitschaft mit und bist motiviert, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – vom Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
- Du hast eine mindestens dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- In Deutsch bist du auf Niveau C2 sicher unterwegs. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn ohne Rot-Grün-Schwäche.
- Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Strafregister- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Das Dokument kann bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellt werden.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Die Einstufung während der Zweitausbildung erfolgt entsprechend der Funktion und dem Alter. Mehr zum konkreten Lohn für diese Rolle findest du unter Quereinstieg .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

descriptionByLocale.it: Gestore circolazione treni ingresso laterale: al 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con accesso laterale: all'aeroporto di Zurigo o allo scalo di Limmattal, previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. In qualità di responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria tieni d'occhio la rete di tratte che ti è stata assegnata, dirigi e monitori i treni sul posto di lavoro con circa otto schermi. Durante il normale funzionamento monitorate il traffico, controllate i processi e assicurate che tutto funzioni senza intoppi. In caso di interruzioni assumete la gestione operativa: analizzate la situazione, avviate misure e risolvete l'interruzione affinché la normalità venga ripristinata il più rapidamente possibile. Ciò significa che condividete la responsabilità della mobilità in Svizzera. Senza di te Internet si ferma. Il lavoro è rilevante per il sistema ed è immediatamente efficace: coordini persone e tecnologia, prendi decisioni rapide e quindi contribuisci direttamente alla sicurezza e all'affidabilità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti offriamo una formazione secondaria retribuita per diventare responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, della durata di otto mesi. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai nella centrale operativa dell'aeroporto di Zurigo o nello scalo di smistamento di Limmattal e contribuirai a garantire che ogni giorno 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino a destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e domenicale paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. I vantaggi come AG gratuita e viaggi all'estero scontati - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. Possibile data di inizio: - 1 marzo 2027 - 1 luglio 2027 - 1 novembre 2027 Puoi spostare questa data. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario, tieni d'occhio la rete di percorsi che ti è stata assegnata, dirigi i treni in modo sicuro ed ecologico e monitori il traffico. - Durante il normale funzionamento osservi il traffico; In caso di interruzioni, agite con calma ed efficienza, intervenite immediatamente e ripristinate la normale operatività. - In caso di interruzioni, si adottano misure per ripristinare la normalità. - Coordini e comunichi con i compagni di squadra, il personale delle locomotive, nonché il personale di costruzione e di manovra. - Sei responsabile delle informazioni sui clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie e garantisci comunicazioni chiare e tempestive. - Grazie al vostro impegno i treni passeggeri e merci viaggiano in sicurezza e puntuali 24 ore su 24. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei affidabile, ti piace lavorare in team e sei disposto a lavorare su turni 24 ore su 24. - Pensi in modo strutturato e in rete. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the operations center at Zurich Airport or in the Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start date: - March 1, 2027 - July 1, 2027 - November 1, 2027 You can move this. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - In German you are confident at level C2. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision Up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst und überwachst die Züge an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit rund acht Bildschirmen. Im Normalbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr, steuerst die Abläufe und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. Damit trägst du die Mitverantwortung für die Mobilität der Schweiz. Ohne dich steht das Netz still. Der Job ist systemrelevant und unmittelbar wirkungsvoll: Du koordinierst Mensch und Technik, triffst rasche Entscheidungen und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs.
Wir bieten dir eine bezahlte Zweitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin oder zum Zugverkehrsleiter, die acht Monate dauert. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung bist du in der Betriebszentrale in Zürich Flughafen oder im Rangierbahnhof Limmattal tätig und hilfst dabei, dass 9000 Personen- und 2000 Güterzüge täglich sicher und pünktlich ihr Ziel erreichen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Infoveranstaltung .
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Sonntagsarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland – auch für die Familie – findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.
Möglicher Starttermin:
- 1. März 2027
- 1. Juli 2027
- 1. November 2027
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst Züge sicher und ökologisch und überwachst den Verkehr.
- Im Regelbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr; bei Störungen handelst du ruhig und effizient, leitest sofort Massnahmen ein und stellst den Normalbetrieb wieder her.
- Bei Störungen leitest du Massnahmen ein, damit der Normalzustand wiederhergestellt wird.
- Du koordinierst und kommunizierst mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokpersonal sowie Bau- und Rangierpersonal.
- Du verantwortest die Kundeninformation an Bahnhöfen und sorgst für klare, zeitnahe Mitteilungen.
- Dank deinem Einsatz sind Personen- und Güterzüge rund um die Uhr sicher und pünktlich unterwegs.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne im Team und bist bereit, im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du denkst strukturiert und vernetzt. In Stresssituationen handelst du schnell und überlegt. Die technische Affinität wird in der Ausbildung gefördert.
- Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Lernbereitschaft mit und bist motiviert, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – vom Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
- Du hast eine mindestens dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- In Deutsch bist du auf Niveau C2 sicher unterwegs. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn ohne Rot-Grün-Schwäche.
- Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Strafregister- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Das Dokument kann bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellt werden.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Die Einstufung während der Zweitausbildung erfolgt entsprechend der Funktion und dem Alter. Mehr zum konkreten Lohn für diese Rolle findest du unter Quereinstieg .

Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Responsable du trafic ferroviaire à entrée latérale: à l'aéroport de Zurich ou à la gare de triage de Limmattal, sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ huit écrans. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Le travail est pertinent pour le système et immédiatement efficace : vous coordonnez les personnes et la technologie, prenez des décisions rapides et contribuez ainsi directement à la sécurité et à la fiabilité du transport ferroviaire. Nous vous proposons une formation secondaire rémunérée pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, d'une durée de huit mois. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et le dimanche, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Lernbereitschaft mit und bist motiviert, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – vom Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
Du hast eine mindestens dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
In Deutsch bist du auf Niveau C2 sicher unterwegs. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn ohne Rot-Grün-Schwäche.

Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Strafregister- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Das Dokument kann bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellt werden.

Dabei bringst du unsere Fahrgäste pünktlich an ihr Ziel und sorgst so für ein positives Reiseerlebnis mit der SBB.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, da du deine Freizeit geniessen kannst, während andere arbeiten. - Während deiner Fahrt bist du achtsam und reagierst schnell und richtig auf Signale, Geschwindigkeitsregelungen sowie unvorhersehbare Ereignisse.

- Du hast eine dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch (Niveau C2) und bringst Anfängerkenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache (Niveau A1) mit.

descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport Ziegelbrücke 12/2026 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport Ziegelbrücke 12/2026 Ziegelbrücke, December 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 508 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage because you can enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent upon consultation, with different part-time models available to you. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. - Thanks to the precisely timed duty schedule, you can start your well-deserved end of work on time and without any further tasks or emails. This is what you bring with you. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of a second national language (level A1). - For safety reasons, you have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness). In addition, you have no entries in the criminal or debt collection register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102270 Marco Gosetti Telephone +41 512 81 53 48 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. descriptionByLocale.fr: Entrée latérale comme conducteur de train : dans le transport de voyageurs Ziegelbrücke 12/2026 100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans le transport de voyageurs Ziegelbrücke 12/2026 Ziegelbrücke, 1er décembre 2026, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 508 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage, car vous pouvez profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. De plus, après une formation de conducteur de train, vous pouvez définir individuellement votre charge de travail à partir de 60 pour cent sur consultation, avec différents modèles à temps partiel qui s'offrent à vous. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels que l'AG gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de train, vous assumez non seulement la tête du train, mais également la responsabilité de la sécurité et de la ponctualité sur le réseau ferroviaire très fréquenté. - Pendant votre voyage, vous êtes attentif et réagissez rapidement et correctement aux signaux, aux contrôles de vitesse et aux événements imprévisibles. - Vous agissez de manière indépendante et êtes à tout moment en contact avec les centres d'opérations et les centres de contrôle. - Outre la conduite et les manœuvres des trains, vos tâches consistent également à vérifier l'état technique avant et après la prise en charge du véhicule. - Grâce à l'horaire de service chronométré avec précision, vous pouvez commencer votre fin de travail bien méritée à temps et sans autres tâches ni e-mails. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous abordez les défis avec calme, prenez des décisions réfléchies même dans des situations stressantes et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts. - Vous avez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de motivation pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante et êtes prêt à vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en classe sur site à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. - Vous avez effectué un apprentissage de trois ans ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in category B100 Cargo 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in category B100 Cargo Oensingen and Lupfig, August 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 100% Apply now You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 14-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich Altstetten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. After training there is the opportunity to work part-time. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. Possible start dates in 2026: - August 1st, 2026 - September 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can do that. - As a locomotive driver in category B100 Cargo, you travel regionally at speeds of up to 100 km/h and deliver freight wagons to customers and pick them up. In this way you make an important contribution to the economy. - You take the lead of the train and are responsible for the safety and punctuality of the freight trains in the busy rail network. - Your high degree of independence helps you to supply the construction sites with the necessary materials on time. - You manage complex shunting movements, act independently, record commercial and operational data in digital systems and ensure customer contact. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have completed at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally basic craft training, or a high school diploma. - You are fluent in the language of the training location, both verbally and in writing (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current criminal record extract (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. This is how you get started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. This is how it goes. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102435 Rico Lohse, team leader Oensingen Telephone +41 79 687 12 65 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. That's what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Du engagierst dich für eine nachhaltige und ganzheitliche Performance im Immobilienbereich. Als Teil eines kompetenten Teams schaffst du Transparenz, gibst Orientierung und begleitest die Geschäftsbereiche als verlässliche Partnerin oder verlässlicher Partner auf dem Weg zu ambitionierten Ergebnissen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe mit dem Business und erweiterst deine Expertise im Finance Business Partnering sowie im Immobilien- und Konzernumfeld. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, fachlicher Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit in einem unterstützenden Team geben dir Raum, Wirkung zu erzielen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Finance Business Partner:in steuerst du Finanzen und Planung für definierte Bereiche der Division Immobilien und leistest einen spürbaren Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Performance.
- Mit Fachwissen und Überzeugungskraft berätst du zu finanziellen Fragestellungen, und du verantwortest fundierte betriebswirtschaftliche Entscheide.
- Mit Erfahrung als Finance Business Partner:in stellst du die Einhaltung übergeordneter finanzieller Vorgaben und Standards sicher, während du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Controlling Service Center und im Division Finance Center zusammenarbeitest.
- Du nutzt Steuerungsinstrumente und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen, um das Business als Co-Pilot auf Augenhöhe zu führen, und du etablierst eine Performance Management Kultur mit konstruktiven, auch kritischen Dialogen.
- Die Befähigung des Business in kommerziellen Fragestellungen liegt ebenfalls in deinem Verantwortungsbereich, damit du Wirkung über den eigenen Bereich hinaus erzielst.
Das bringst du mit.
- Mit gewinnender Persönlichkeit und ausgeprägter Kommunikationsstärke begegnest du Widerständen konstruktiv, überzeugst auch kritische Stimmen und führst gemeinsame Lösungen konsequent zum Ziel.
- Strategischer Weitblick, analytisches Denken und hohe IT-Affinität helfen dir, datenbasiert zu argumentieren und tragfähige Empfehlungen abzugeben.
- Eigeninitiative und Lust auf Weiterentwicklung treiben dich an, Fachthemen und das Business kontinuierlich voranzubringen.
- Beratungsgeschick im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zeichnet dich aus und ergänzt unser Team spürbar.
- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen oder Controlling an Uni oder FH und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit, idealerweise im Bahnumfeld, im Immobiliensektor oder in einem Grosskonzern.
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch (C2) und bringst gute Französischkenntnisse (B1) mit.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau K, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Partner commerciale finanziario: presso FFS Immobilien Berna o Zurigo / Work Smart, 1 settembre 2026 o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Ti impegni per prestazioni sostenibili e olistiche nel settore immobiliare. Facendo parte di un team competente create trasparenza, fornite orientamento e sostenete i settori aziendali come partner affidabile sulla strada verso risultati ambiziosi. Ti assumi responsabilità allo stesso livello dell'azienda e amplia le tue competenze nei partner commerciali finanziari, nonché nell'ambiente immobiliare e aziendale. Opportunità di sviluppo, scambio professionale e collaborazione in un team di supporto ti danno lo spazio per avere un impatto e svilupparti ulteriormente. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di Finance Business Partner gestisci le finanze e la pianificazione per aree definite della divisione Real Estate e fornisci un notevole contributo alla performance sostenibile. - Con conoscenze specialistiche e persuasività fornite consulenza su questioni finanziarie e siete responsabili di decisioni aziendali fondate. - Con l'esperienza come partner aziendale finanziario, garantirai la conformità ai requisiti e agli standard finanziari generali lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi del Centro servizi di controllo e del Centro finanziario della divisione. - Utilizzi strumenti di controllo e basi decisionali affidabili per gestire l'azienda come copilota su un piano di parità e stabilisci una cultura di gestione delle prestazioni con dialoghi costruttivi e critici. - Anche il rafforzamento dell'azienda nelle questioni commerciali è una tua responsabilità in modo da ottenere un impatto oltre la tua area. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Con una personalità vincente e forti capacità di comunicazione, rispondi alla resistenza in modo costruttivo, convinci le voci critiche e raggiungi costantemente soluzioni comuni. - La lungimiranza strategica, il pensiero analitico e un alto livello di affinità IT ti aiutano a discutere sulla base dei dati e a formulare raccomandazioni praticabili. - La tua iniziativa e il tuo desiderio di ulteriore sviluppo ti spingono a portare avanti continuamente argomenti specialistici e il business. - Le capacità di consulenza nella comunicazione con diverse parti interessate ti distinguono e completano notevolmente il nostro team. - Avere una laurea in economia aziendale, finanza o controllo presso un'università o una scuola superiore e avere diversi anni di esperienza in un ruolo comparabile, preferibilmente nell'ambiente ferroviario, nel settore immobiliare o in una grande azienda. - Parli fluentemente il tedesco (C2) e hai una buona conoscenza del francese (B1). ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito K, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione definitiva luglio 2026 Domanda Decisione definitiva luglio 2026 Hai domande? Informazioni sul processo di candidatura Supporto Recruiting FFS Telefono + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu Domande frequenti sulla candidatura Alla posizione ID lavoro 103424 Simon Kilchenmann, responsabile Finanze Business Partnering FFS Immobili Telefono +41 79 504 18 79 Purtroppo non è possibile prendere in considerazione candidature via e-mail. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Finance Business Partner:in SBB Real Estate 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Finance Business Partner: in SBB Immobilien Bern or Zurich / Work Smart, September 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You are committed to sustainable and holistic performance in the real estate sector. As part of a competent team, you create transparency, provide orientation and support the business areas as a reliable partner on the way to ambitious results. You take on responsibility on an equal level with the business and expand your expertise in finance business partnering as well as in the real estate and corporate environment. Development opportunities, professional exchange and collaboration in a supportive team give you space to make an impact and develop further. You can move that. - As a Finance Business Partner, you manage finances and planning for defined areas of the Real Estate Division and make a noticeable contribution to sustainable performance. - With specialist knowledge and persuasiveness, you advise on financial issues and are responsible for well-founded business decisions. - With experience as a Finance Business Partner, you will ensure compliance with overarching financial requirements and standards while working closely with colleagues in the Controlling Service Center and the Division Finance Center. - You use control instruments and reliable decision-making bases to manage the business as a co-pilot on an equal footing, and you establish a performance management culture with constructive and critical dialogues. - Empowering the business in commercial issues is also your responsibility so that you achieve impact beyond your own area. This is what you bring with you. - With a winning personality and strong communication skills, you respond to resistance constructively, convince critical voices and consistently achieve common solutions. - Strategic foresight, analytical thinking and a high level of IT affinity help you to argue based on data and make viable recommendations. - Your initiative and desire for further development drive you to continually advance specialist topics and the business. - Consulting skills in communicating with different stakeholders set you apart and noticeably complement our team. - You have completed a university degree in business administration, finance or controlling at a university or college and have several years of experience in a comparable role, ideally in the railway environment, in the real estate sector or in a large corporation. - You are fluent in German (C2) and have good knowledge of French (B1). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level K, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision July 2026 Application Final decision July 2026 Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103424 Simon Kilchenmann, Head of Finance Business Partnering SBB Real Estate Telephone +41 79 504 18 79 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

- Du prüfst ausgeführte Arbeiten sorgfältig und stellst eine saubere Ausführung sicher.

- Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team, Einsatzbereitschaft und der Anspruch, Arbeiten sorgfältig und engagiert auszuführenKörperliche Belastbarkeit, handwerkliches Geschick und gute Koordination.

Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience in Erstfeld, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103356 Christian Diener Telephone +41 79 505 05 94 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Auf dich wartet ein spannendes, innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du grosse Veränderungen antreiben kannst und so zur Digitalisierung der SBB beiträgst. Bei UHR (Unterhalt Rollmaterial) wirst du eine Schlüsselposition im Werk Olten haben, mit vielen Aufgaben, Verantwortungen, um unsere Kunden mit deinem vollen Einsatz zu unterstützen. Gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkollegen erarbeitest du Lösungswege für aktuelle Herausforderungen und setzt diese im Team um. Auch Weiterbildungen kommen für die individuelle Berufsentwicklung nicht zu kurz.
Im Werk Olten arbeitest du aktuell im Zweischichtbetrieb von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 04.45 Uhr und 17.45 Uhr.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Rangierspezialist:in bewegst du unter Anleitung des Manöverkoordinators Reise- und Güterzugwagen.
- In dein Tätigkeitsgebiet gehört u.a. das An- und Abhängen der verschiedenen Wagen und die Bedienung der Handweichen sowie dem Stellwerk. Dabei arbeitest du nach den Fahrdiendienstvorschriften und den vorgeschriebenen Standards der SBB.
- Inbetriebnahmen von und fahren mit Trieb- und Gliederzügen gehören ebenfalls in deinen Aufgabenbereich.
- Du fährst mit Rangierlokomotiven, Zweiwegefahrzeugen, führst Bremsproben durch und erstellst die Fahrbereitschaft. Zudem bist du für den Kleinunterhalt der Fahrzeuge zuständig.
- Kundenzufriedenheit ist eines unserer obersten Ziele. Für unsere Kunden bist du täglich im Einsatz. Du lebst unsere Sicherheitskultur und wendest den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) konstant an.
Das bringst du mit.
- Damit du diese verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe erfolgreich wahrnehmen kannst, bist du geistig und körperlich fit und in guter Verfassung.
- Du zeichnest dich durch dein vernetztes Denken und Handeln, deine Belastbarkeit, deine Selbstständigkeit sowie deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, aus.
- Ausgeprägtes Teamplay sowie eine überdurchschnittlich hohe Kunden- und Qualitätsorientierung sind weitere Attribute, die deinen Charakter gut beschreiben.
- Für die anspruchsvolle Position benötigst du eine abgeschlossene Grundausbildung EFZ, idealerweise als Logistiker:in Verkehr oder eine ähnliche Ausbildung in handwerklicher/technischer Richtung.
- Du verfügst idealerweise über eine Ausbildung und Erfahrung im Rangierdienst, verbunden mit fahrdienstlichem Begleiten gemäss BAV Ausweis VTE A40 direkt. Alternativ bist du Rangierbegleiter:in Ai40 indirekt und bringst die Bereitschaft zur Ausbildung VTE A40 direkt mit.

Macchinista: in manovra o specialista in manovra: a Olten, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro entusiasmante e innovativo in cui potrete guidare grandi cambiamenti e contribuire così alla digitalizzazione delle FFS. In UHR (manutenzione materiale rotabile) avrai una posizione chiave nello stabilimento di Olten, con molti compiti e responsabilità per supportare i nostri clienti con il tuo pieno impegno. Insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, svilupperai soluzioni alle sfide attuali e le implementerai come una squadra. Anche la formazione continua non viene trascurata per lo sviluppo professionale individuale. Nello stabilimento di Olten attualmente lavorate su due turni dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 4:45 alle 17:45. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di specialista delle manovre, sposti vagoni passeggeri e merci sotto la guida del coordinatore di manovra. - La tua area di attività comprende, tra le altre cose, il fissaggio e lo sgancio dei vari carri e l'azionamento degli interruttori manuali e della cassetta di segnalazione. Lavorate nel rispetto delle prescrizioni del servizio di trasporto e degli standard prescritti dalle FFS. - Anche la messa in servizio e la guida di più unità e treni articolati rientrano nella vostra area di responsabilità. - Guidi locomotive da manovra, veicoli strada-rotaia, effettui prove di frenata e ti assicuri che siano pronti per la guida. Sei anche responsabile della piccola manutenzione dei veicoli. - La soddisfazione del cliente è uno dei nostri obiettivi principali. Lavori per i nostri clienti ogni giorno. Vivi la nostra cultura della sicurezza e applichi costantemente il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP). Questo è quello che porti con te. - Affinché tu possa svolgere con successo questo compito di responsabilità, devi essere mentalmente e fisicamente in forma e in buona forma. - Sei caratterizzato dal tuo pensiero e dalle tue azioni in rete, dalla tua resilienza, dalla tua indipendenza e dalla tua volontà di assumerti la responsabilità. - Un forte gioco di squadra, un orientamento al cliente e alla qualità superiore alla media sono ulteriori attributi che descrivono bene il tuo carattere. - Per la posizione impegnativa è necessario aver completato la formazione di base EFZ, preferibilmente come specialista della logistica nei trasporti o una formazione simile in ambito artigianale/tecnico. - Idealmente avete formazione ed esperienza nel campo delle manovre, abbinate all'accompagnamento di guida secondo la carta d'identità BAV VTE A40 direct. In alternativa sei addetto di manovra Ai40 indirettamente e sei disposto a partecipare alla formazione VTE A40. - Possiedi buone competenze linguistiche scritte e orali in tedesco (almeno livello B2). ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici.
