Train driver: in shunting or shunting specialist: in Olten, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. An exciting, innovative working environment awaits you in which you can drive big changes and thus contribute to the digitalization of SBB. At UHR (maintenance rolling stock) you will have a key position in the Olten plant, with many tasks and responsibilities in order to support our customers with your full commitment. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for individual professional development. At the Olten plant you are currently working in two shifts from Monday to Friday between 4:45 a.m. and 5:45 p.m. You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you move passenger and freight train cars under the guidance of the maneuver coordinator. - Your area of ​​activity includes, among other things, attaching and detaching the various wagons and operating the manual switches and the signal box. You work in accordance with the transport service regulations and the prescribed standards of the SBB. - Commissioning and driving multiple units and articulated trains are also part of your area of ​​responsibility. - You drive shunting locomotives, road-rail vehicles, carry out brake tests and ensure that they are ready to drive. You are also responsible for the small maintenance of the vehicles. - Customer satisfaction is one of our top goals. You work for our customers every day. You live our safety culture and constantly apply the continuous improvement process (CIP). This is what you bring with you. - In order for you to be able to carry out this responsible task successfully, you must be mentally and physically fit and in good shape. - You are characterized by your networked thinking and actions, your resilience, your independence and your willingness to take responsibility. - Strong team play as well as an above-average customer and quality orientation are further attributes that describe your character well. - For the demanding position, you need to have completed basic EFZ training, ideally as a logistics specialist in transport or similar training in a craft/technical direction. - Ideally, you have training and experience in shunting, combined with driving accompaniment in accordance with the BAV ID card VTE A40 direct. Alternatively, you are an Ai40 shunting attendant indirectly and are willing to take part in VTE A40 training. - You have good written and oral language skills in German (at least level B2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Shift manager: in Transport Oensingen, September 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a shift leader, you are responsible for operational management during the shift assigned to you and represent the team leader during this time. - In the team you are responsible for the operational management of personnel, trains and vehicles. You make functional instructions and assign them as needed to the group that is your area of ​​responsibility. - You ensure that safety rules and processes, as well as punctuality and safety, are adhered to when preparing trains in your area. - If there are deviations, you will take action independently to keep the impact on customers and operations as low as possible. - You represent the interests of SBB Cargo in the event of an incident. Based on your observations, you provide important information on how to improve processes and the use of resources. This is what you bring with you. - You enjoy working in a team and respect different personalities, you work independently and quickly find a good solution, even in difficult situations. You are actively committed to the safety of your colleagues and are a role model in everyday life. - You have comprehensive social and professional skills. You value making decisions in unforeseen situations. - Completed vocational training or several years of professional experience in the field of shunting as well as a good command of the local language are required. - A secure use of Office 365 is a matter of course for you, as is the application of the working time regulations of the GAV and the AZG. - You have a lot of experience in maneuvering. ## Your salary and your benefits. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Liebst du es, draussen in der Natur zu arbeiten und willst Ende des Tages sehen, was du erreicht hast? Bei uns übernimmst du abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, arbeitest selbstständig und gleichzeitig im Team. Ein motiviertes, zuverlässiges Team unterstützt dich tatkräftig und freut sich darauf, gemeinsam mit dir Grosses zu erreichen!
Werde Teil unseres Teams an den Standorten: Muttenz und Rapperswil.
Deine Arbeitszeiten sind abwechslungsreich und bieten dir Flexibilität für deine Freizeit. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeit wird zusätzlich vergütet – z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Dank den Zeitzuschlägen hast du mehr freie Tage als Mitarbeitende ohne Einsätze zu diesen Zeiten. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von zahlreichen Benefits wie Kinderzulagen, einem kostenlosen GA 2. Klasse sowie vergünstigten Reisen im Ausland für dich und deine Familie. Alle Details findest du auf unserer Website unter « Benefits ».
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Unterhalt und Erneuerung der Kabelanlagen unserer Infrastruktur und leistest so einen wichtigen Beitrag zu Sicherheit, Qualität und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen.
- Unterhalts-, Erneuerungs- und Sanierungsarbeiten an Kabeltrassen und in Kabelschächten führst du selbstständig und im Team aus.
- Externe Dienstleister leitest du fachlich an und berätst sie, und du koordinierst Material sowie Lieferungen auf der Baustelle.
- Du baust und wartest Mastfundamente zuverlässig.
- Ausgeführte Arbeiten rapportierst du und du erfasst deine Arbeitszeiten und Spesen.
- Als Sicherheitschef:in überwachst du die Sicherheitsmassnahmen gemäss Sicherheitsdispositiv und bei Interesse übernimmst du Einsätze als Sicherheitswärter:in nach entsprechender Schulung.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bringst hohe Verantwortungsbereitschaft und ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein mit und arbeitest gern bei jeder Witterung im Freien.
- Du verfügst gemäss unseren Sicherheitsvorgaben über einen guten Gesundheitszustand mit uneingeschränktem Hör- und Sehvermögen.
- Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung als Sicherheitswärter:in mit oder du bist bereit, die Ausbildung zu absolvieren und bei Bedarf Einsätze zu übernehmen.
- Einen Führerausweis Kategorie B hast du, mit Vorteil auch Kategorie BE, oder du bist bereit, diesen zu erwerben für Materialtransporte und Einsätze mit Anhänger.
- Mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln gehst du sicher um und du nutzt Smartphone, Tablet und Office-Anwendungen im Alltag.
- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Grundausbildung mit EFZ als Landschaftsgärtner:in, Maurer:in, Tiefbauer:in oder Verkehrswegbauer:in und du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch in Wort und Schrift.

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. -

Faites bouger la Suisse avec nous.
Chef·fe de team Objets de placement développement Région Centre
Berne / Work Smart, entrée en fonction immédiate ou à convenir, 60-100%
Postuler ici

## Ce qui vous attend.
Dans le rôle de responsable Développement des biens immobiliers pour la Région Centre, vous occupez une position clé dans le développement de nos objets immobiliers. Vous faites partie d'une équipe dynamique qui se concentre sur le développement de quartiers et de bâtiments représentant un volume d'investissement de plus de 5 millions. L'accent est mis sur la gestion des parties prenantes, la communication et les compétences de négociation afin de définir de manière optimale les cadres techniques, juridiques et politiques de nos zones de développement.
Ce que vous pouvez faire bouger.
- Dans le cadre de cette fonction exigeante, vous êtes responsable de divers projets de développement immobilier, depuis l'étude de faisabilité jusqu'à l'obtention de l'autorisation officielle du plan d'aménagement spécifique.
- Votre équipe est chargée de mener des études et, en collaboration avec des équipes de planification interdisciplinaires, de développer des idées pour des projets de développement complexes. Ensemble, vous coordonnez les différents acteurs et définissez, avec les parties prenantes, des concepts d'affectation, d'investissement et de mise en œuvre.
- Grâce à une gestion efficace des parties prenantes et à une communication claire, vous assurez des décisions coordonnées sur les questions juridiques, techniques et politiques.
- En tant que cadre, vous dirigez 5 à 7 collaborateur·trice·s , développez les talents et favorisez une culture axée sur les solutions, en particulier pour des projets financièrement exigeants.
- Sur le plan opérationnel, vous mettez la main à la pâte et suivez activement les projets, apportez des impulsions pragmatiques si nécessaire et assumez la responsabilité des délais, des coûts et de la qualité.
Ce que vous apportez.
- Grâce à vos talents de communication et de persuasion, vous suscitez l'enthousiasme et motivez les différentes parties prenantes.
- Vous disposez de solides compétences en gestion des parties prenantes ainsi que d'un réseau régional (région Centre BS/BE) et intégrez proactivement les parties prenantes dans les processus de développement afin de résoudre avec succès les défis.
- Vous apportez des compétences en management et en leadership que vous développez dans la collaboration avec les chef·fe·s d'équipe et les chef·fe·s de projet.
- Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme HES/Université en aménagement du territoire, géographie, Real Estate, développement immobilier ou gestion immobilière, idéalement complété par des connaissances en construction et en gestion d'entreprise.
- Vous justifiez d'une expérience avérée dans le développement immobilier avec des projets d'un volume d'investissement à partir de 5 millions, ainsi que de solides connaissances en matière de planification d'affectations spéciales et des phases SIA de planification et de mise en œuvre.
- La maîtrise de l'allemand à l'oral comme à l'écrit, des connaissances en italien (min. B2) et, idéalement, en français complètent votre profil.

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Rund 14 000 Mitarbeitende des Personenverkehrs sorgen dafür, dass die über 1,4 Mio. Kundinnen und Kunden der SBB, welche wir täglich befördern, einen einfachen Zugang zum Öffentlichen Verkehr erhalten und sowohl sicher als auch pünktlich von A nach B reisen. Das Rangierpersonal als zentrale Berufsgruppe leistet dafür einen zentralen Beitrag. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB bewegst, sowie eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung. Zudem hast du verschiedene interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Für Nachteinsätze erhältst du zusätzlich Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30 %. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du bereitest Personenzüge auf ihre Fahrt vor und bewegst sie im Bahnhof sowie in dessen Umgebung (bis max. 40 km/h) an den richtigen Ausgangsort.
- Dabei stellst du Züge zusammen, trennst einzelne Wagen und sorgst dafür, dass alles am richtigen Platz ist.
- Du machst den Zug startklar, überprüfst die wichtigsten Funktionen und führst Bremskontrollen durch.
- Während deiner Arbeit behältst du den Überblick und sorgst dafür, dass alle Abläufe sicher und reibungslos funktionieren.
- Kleinere Störungen behebst du selbstständig oder meldest sie an die zuständige Stelle weiter.

Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Goldau, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Zug, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Rapperswil SG, October 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Olten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Du möchtest einen Job, in dem jeder deiner Handgriffe zählt? Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.
Du hast eine Berufslehre im mechanischen-handwerklichen Bereich abgeschlossen und möchtest in einem spannenden und innovativen Arbeitsumfeld etwas bewegen, das Sinn macht? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen an diesen Standorten der Deutschschweiz Unterstützung: Zürich, Sargans, Brugg, Rapperswil, Winterthur und Gossau SG.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche im Fitnesscenter trainieren, in der Badi die Sonne geniessen, einkaufen ohne anstehen – einfach deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten. Pikett, Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet. Je nach Einsätzen zahlen wir zusätzlich zwischen 300 und 700 CHF pro Monat. Zudem erhältst du 10-30% Zeitzuschläge. Das bedeutet, du kannst diese Zeitzuschläge mit Freizeit kompensieren. Unsere weiteren Benefits wie Kinderzulagen, kostenloses 2. Klasse GA und vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter « Benefits ».
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du suchst eine spannende, vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, mit der du einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Kundinnen und Kunden der SBB leisten kannst? Grosse und moderne Maschinen begeistern dich ebenso wie verantwortungsvolle und komplexe Aufgaben.
- In deiner neuen Funktion kümmerst du dich, abhängig von deiner Qualifikation und deinem Know-how, um den Bau, Unterhalt und die Instandhaltung der bahntechnischen Anlagen wie Fahrleitungen, Gleise, Weichen, Barrieren, Signale oder Zugsicherungssysteme. Es handelt sich hierbei um eine Pool-Ausschreibung für sämtliche Stellen im oben erwähnten Bereich. Anhand deiner Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Ausbildungen ermitteln wir die bestgeeignete Einstiegsmöglichkeit für dich. Mehr zu unseren spannenden Berufsbildern findest du: hier .
- Als Teamplayer hilfst du mit, dass Störungen schnell lokalisiert und behoben werden. Du packst gerne mit an und hast Freude daran, zu jeder Jahreszeit im Freien zu arbeiten. Im Team meisterst du anspruchsvolle, hauptsächlich mechanische/handwerkliche Arbeiten an unseren Anlagen. Damit leistest du einen wertvollen Beitrag, sodass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden pünktlich und sicher an ihr Ziel gelangen.
- Unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten (teilweise auch am Wochenende) und/oder Schichtarbeit siehst du als Vorteil für deine flexible Freizeitgestaltung.
Das bringst du mit.
- Ein hohes Verantwortungs- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein ist für dich selbstverständlich. Teamwork und Gemeinschaft sind dir genauso wichtig wie uns. In unserer Branche sind Teamplayer der Schlüssel zum gemeinsamen Erfolg.
- Du packst gerne mit an und bist neuen digitalen Hilfsmitteln gegenüber offen. Sich kontinuierlich weiterzubilden ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du freust dich auf interne Aus- und Weiterbildungen bei vollem Lohn.
- Du hast eine abgeschlossene mechanische-handwerkliche Grundausbildung EBA oder EFZ (Produktionsmechaniker:in, Polymechaniker:in, Landmaschinenmechaniker:in, allgemeiner Mechaniker:in, Schlosser:in in der Baubranche oder ähnliche Berufe, z. B. Landschaftsgärtner:in).

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Cambio di carriera: nel mondo delle professioni meccaniche e artigianali 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Cambio di carriera: nel mondo delle professioni meccaniche e artigianali nella Svizzera tedesca, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Vuoi un lavoro in cui ogni mossa che fai conta? Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. Hai completato un apprendistato nel settore meccanico e artigianale e vorresti fare la differenza in un ambiente lavorativo stimolante e innovativo? Allora sei nel posto giusto!
• Cerchiamo supporto in queste località della Svizzera tedesca: Zurigo, Brugg, Rapperswil e Winterthur. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Puoi allenarti nel centro fitness durante la settimana, goderti il ​​sole in piscina, fare shopping senza fare la fila: rendi semplicemente più flessibile il tuo tempo libero. Paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro di guardia, notturno e nei fine settimana. A seconda degli incarichi paghiamo un supplemento tra 300 e 700 CHF al mese. Riceverai anche bonus di tempo del 10-30%. Ciò significa che puoi compensare queste indennità di tempo con tempo libero. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - Siete alla ricerca di un compito entusiasmante, vario e vario con cui potete dare un prezioso contributo ai clienti delle FFS? Le macchine grandi e moderne ti entusiasmano tanto quanto i compiti responsabili e complessi. - Nel tuo nuovo ruolo, a seconda delle tue qualifiche e competenze, sarai responsabile della costruzione, manutenzione e riparazione di sistemi ferroviari come linee aeree, binari, scambi, barriere, segnali o sistemi di protezione dei treni. Questo è un annuncio di pool per tutte le posizioni nell'area sopra menzionata. In base alle tue competenze, esperienza e formazione determineremo l'opportunità di ingresso più adatta a te. Puoi scoprire di più sui nostri interessanti profili lavorativi qui. - In qualità di giocatore di squadra, contribuirai a garantire che le interruzioni vengano rapidamente individuate e risolte. Ti piace dare una mano e ti piace lavorare all'aperto in tutte le stagioni. Come squadra, padroneggerete lavori impegnativi, principalmente meccanici/manuali, sui nostri sistemi. In questo modo fornite un prezioso contributo affinché i nostri clienti raggiungano la loro destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. - Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare (a volte nei fine settimana) e/o il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per le tue attività ricreative flessibili. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Un alto senso di responsabilità e sicurezza è un dato di fatto per te. Il lavoro di squadra e la comunità sono importanti per te quanto lo sono per noi. Nel nostro settore, i giochi di squadra sono la chiave del successo condiviso. - Ti piace dare una mano e sei aperto ai nuovi strumenti digitali. Per te la formazione continua è un dato di fatto. Attendi con ansia la formazione interna e l'istruzione superiore con retribuzione piena. - Avere completato la formazione meccanica e artigianale di base EBA o EFZ (meccanico di produzione, polimeccanico, meccanico di macchine agricole, meccanico generale, fabbro nel settore edile o professioni simili, ad es. giardiniere paesaggista). - Per poter svolgere il servizio di guardia è necessario essere in possesso della patente di guida di categoria B. Abbiamo bisogno di udito e vista illimitati, nonché di buona salute. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 2. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione finale 5 - 6 settimane dal ricevimento della domanda Domanda Decisione finale 5 - 6 settimane dal ricevimento della domanda Domande? Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. descriptionByLocale.en: Career changer: in the world of mechanical and craft professions 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Career changer: in the world of mechanical and craft professions in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Do you want a job where every move you make counts? At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. Have you completed an apprenticeship in the mechanical and craft sector and would you like to make a difference in an exciting and innovative working environment? Then you've come to the right place! We are looking for support in these locations in German-speaking Switzerland: Zurich, Brugg, Rapperswil and Winterthur. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. You can train in the fitness center during the week, enjoy the sun in the swimming pool, go shopping without queuing - simply make your free time more flexible. We pay additional compensation for on-call, night and weekend work. Depending on the assignments, we pay an additional between 300 and 700 CHF per month. You also receive 10-30% time bonuses. This means that you can compensate for these time allowances with free time. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - Are you looking for an exciting, diverse and varied task with which you can make a valuable contribution to SBB's customers? You are just as excited about large, modern machines as you are about responsible and complex tasks. - In your new role, depending on your qualifications and know-how, you will be responsible for the construction, maintenance and repair of railway systems such as overhead lines, tracks, switches, barriers, signals or train protection systems. This is a pool advertisement for all positions in the above-mentioned area. Based on your skills, experience and training, we will determine the most suitable entry opportunity for you. You can find out more about our exciting job profiles here. - As a team player, you will help ensure that disruptions are quickly located and resolved. You like to lend a hand and enjoy working outdoors in all seasons. As a team, you will master demanding, mainly mechanical/manual work on our systems. In doing so, you make a valuable contribution to ensuring that our customers reach their destination safely and on time. - You see irregular working hours (sometimes on weekends) and/or shift work as an advantage for your flexible leisure activities. This is what you bring with you. - A high sense of responsibility and safety is a given for you. Teamwork and community are just as important to you as they are to us. In our industry, team players are the key to shared success. - You like to lend a hand and are open to new digital tools. Continuous training is a given for you. You look forward to internal training and further education with full pay. - You have completed basic mechanical and craft training EBA or EFZ (production mechanic, polymechanic, agricultural machinery mechanic, general mechanic, locksmith in the construction industry or similar professions, e.g. landscape gardener). - In order to be able to perform on-call duty, you must have a category B driving license. We require unrestricted hearing and vision as well as good health. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision 5 - 6 weeks after receipt of application Application Final decision 5 - 6 weeks after receipt of application Any questions? For the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ for the application To the position Job ID 102015 Sidney Aeschbacher, regional representative for pool recruiting central Telephone 051 285 19 90 Thomas Werle, regional representative for pool recruiting East Telephone 051 285 24 43 Applications by email are unfortunately not possible be taken into account. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Changeur de carrière : dans le monde des métiers de la mécanique et de l'artisanat en Suisse alémanique, dès maintenant ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Voulez-vous un travail où chaque geste que vous faites compte ? Chez CFF, vous avez la possibilité d'utiliser vos compétences tout en acquérant de nouvelles compétences qui enrichiront et feront progresser votre carrière. Vous avez effectué un apprentissage dans le secteur de la mécanique et de l'artisanat et vous souhaitez faire la différence dans un environnement de travail passionnant et innovant ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit ! Nous recherchons du soutien dans ces localités de Suisse alémanique : Zurich, Brugg, Rapperswil et Winterthur. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Vous pouvez vous entraîner au centre de remise en forme pendant la semaine, profiter du soleil dans la piscine, faire du shopping sans faire la queue - tout simplement rendre votre temps libre plus flexible. Nous versons une indemnité complémentaire pour le travail de garde, de nuit et de week-end. Selon les missions, nous payons un supplément entre 300 et 700 CHF par mois. Vous recevez également des bonus de temps de 10 à 30 %. Cela signifie que vous pouvez compenser ces heures perdues par du temps libre. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous recherchez une tâche passionnante, diversifiée et variée avec laquelle vous pourrez apporter une contribution précieuse aux clients des CFF ? Vous êtes tout aussi enthousiasmé par les grandes machines modernes que par les tâches responsables et complexes. - Dans votre nouveau rôle, en fonction de vos qualifications et de votre savoir-faire, vous serez responsable de la construction, de l'entretien et de la réparation des systèmes ferroviaires tels que les caténaires, les voies, les aiguillages, les barrières, la signalisation ou les systèmes de protection des trains. Il s'agit d'une annonce de pool pour tous les postes dans le domaine mentionné ci-dessus. En fonction de vos compétences, de votre expérience et de votre formation, nous déterminerons l’opportunité d’entrée la plus adaptée pour vous. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur nos profils d’emploi passionnants ici. - En tant qu'esprit d'équipe, vous contribuerez à ce que les perturbations soient rapidement localisées et résolues. Vous aimez donner un coup de main et appréciez travailler dehors en toutes saisons. En équipe, vous maîtriserez des travaux exigeants, principalement mécaniques/manuels, sur nos systèmes. Ce faisant, vous apportez une contribution précieuse pour garantir que nos clients atteignent leur destination en toute sécurité et à temps. - Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers (parfois le week-end) et/ou le travail posté comme un avantage pour vos loisirs flexibles. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Un sens élevé des responsabilités et de la sécurité est une évidence pour vous. Le travail d’équipe et la communauté sont tout aussi importants pour vous que pour nous. Dans notre secteur, l’esprit d’équipe est la clé du succès partagé. - Vous aimez donner un coup de main et êtes ouvert aux nouveaux outils numériques. La formation continue est une évidence pour vous. Vous attendez avec impatience une formation interne et une formation continue avec un salaire complet. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base mécanique et artisanale EBA ou EFZ (mécanicien de production, polymécanicien, mécanicien de machines agricoles, mécanicien général, serrurier du bâtiment ou professions assimilées, par ex. paysagiste). - Pour pouvoir effectuer des astreintes, vous devez être titulaire d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B. Nous avons besoin d’une audition et d’une vision sans restriction ainsi que d’une bonne santé. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence D, niveau d'allocation régionale 2. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Für unseren Stützpunkt in Zürich suchen wir engagierte und motivierte Polizist:innen, die sich einer spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Stelle widmen möchten. Bei uns steht nicht die Büroarbeit im Vordergrund, sondern die bürgernahe Polizeiarbeit am Puls des Geschehens im öffentlichen Verkehr mit einem klaren Fokus auf die sicherheitspolizeilichen Aufgaben. Zudem arbeiten wir regelmässig mit anderen Polizeikräften und Partnerorganisationen zusammen, was dein Netzwerk erweitern wird. Werde Teil eines wertschätzenden, dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das über die Kantonsgrenzen hinaus für Sicherheit und Ordnung sorgt.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Unsere weiteren Benefits wie Kinderzulagen, kostenloses 2. Klasse GA und vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter «Benefits».
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Polizist:in der Transportpolizei SBB sorgst du national mit über 190 Kollegen:innen in den Bahnhöfen und in den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln verschiedener Transportunternehmen für Sicherheit, Ruhe und Ordnung.
- Du leistest uniformierte und auch zivile Präsenz in Transportmitteln, in Bahnhöfen und auf dem Areal der Transportunternehmen.
- Dabei trägst du zum Schutz und zur Sicherheit unserer Reisenden und des Personals des öffentlichen Verkehrs bei.
- Mit polizeilichen Interventionen, auch zusammen mit Partnerorganisationen, übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Sicherheit und Ordnung.
- Zu den spannenden Herausforderungen gehören auch Einsätze in Eventzügen und an Grossanlässen im Einsatzgebiet Schweiz.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist eine dienstleistungsorientierte, offene und gewinnende Persönlichkeit, da du täglich im Kontakt mit unseren Kunden:innen stehst.
- Bei uns ist Teamwork der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und freust dich auf die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
- Du verfügst über den eidgenössischen Fachausweis Polizist:in I und bringst gute polizeitaktische und -technische Kenntnisse mit.
- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksweise in der deutschen Sprache zeichnen dich aus. Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache sind von Vorteil.
- Gute IT- und administrative Kenntnisse, welche du zielorientiert einsetzen kannst, bringst du ebenfalls mit.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau H, Regionalzulage Stufe 2. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.

descriptionByLocale.it: Agente di polizia: nella polizia dei trasporti 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Agente di polizia: nell'ufficio della polizia dei trasporti di Zurigo, 1 luglio 2025 o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Per la nostra sede di Zurigo cerchiamo agenti di polizia impegnati e motivati ​​che vogliano dedicarsi a un posto entusiasmante e vario. Per noi l’attenzione non è sul lavoro d’ufficio, ma sulla polizia di prossimità, al passo con ciò che accade nel trasporto pubblico, con una chiara attenzione ai compiti della polizia di sicurezza. Collaboriamo regolarmente anche con altre forze di polizia e organizzazioni partner, che amplieranno la tua rete. Entrate a far parte di un team riconoscente, dinamico e motivato che garantisce la sicurezza e l'ordine oltre i confini del cantone. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di agente della Polizia dei trasporti FFS, tu e oltre 190 colleghi garantite la sicurezza, la tranquillità e l'ordine nelle stazioni ferroviarie e sui trasporti pubblici di diverse aziende di trasporto. - Presti una presenza in uniforme e civile sui mezzi di trasporto, nelle stazioni ferroviarie e nei locali delle aziende di trasporto. - Contribuisci alla protezione e alla sicurezza dei nostri viaggiatori e del personale dei trasporti pubblici. - Con gli interventi della polizia, anche insieme alle organizzazioni partner, ti assumi la responsabilità della sicurezza e dell'ordine. - Le sfide entusiasmanti comprendono anche l'impiego nei treni degli eventi e in occasione di grandi eventi nell'area operativa svizzera. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei una personalità orientata al servizio, aperta e vincente, poiché sei a contatto quotidiano con i nostri clienti. - Per noi il lavoro di squadra è la chiave del successo. Sei un giocatore di squadra e non vedi l'ora di lavorare insieme come una squadra. - Possiedi il certificato di ufficiale di polizia federale I e hai buone conoscenze tattiche e tecniche di polizia. - Sei caratterizzato da un'ottima espressione orale e scritta in lingua tedesca. La conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale costituisce titolo preferenziale. - Possiedi inoltre buone conoscenze informatiche e amministrative, che puoi utilizzare in modo orientato agli obiettivi. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito H, livello di indennità regionale 2. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione finale Domanda Decisione finale Domande? Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer: in transport police base Zurich, July 1st, 2025 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. For our base in Zurich, we are looking for committed and motivated police officers who would like to dedicate themselves to an exciting and varied position. For us, the focus is not on office work, but on community policing at the pulse of what is happening in public transport with a clear focus on security police tasks. We also work regularly with other police forces and partner organizations, which will expand your network. Become part of an appreciative, dynamic and motivated team that ensures security and order beyond the canton's borders. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you and over 190 colleagues will ensure safety, peace and order in the train stations and on public transport from various transport companies. - You provide a uniformed and civilian presence in means of transport, in train stations and on the premises of the transport companies. - You contribute to the protection and safety of our travelers and public transport staff. - With police interventions, also together with partner organizations, you take responsibility for security and order. - The exciting challenges also include deployments in event trains and at major events in the Swiss operational area. This is what you bring with you. - You are a service-oriented, open and winning personality, as you are in daily contact with our customers. - For us, teamwork is the key to success. You are a team player and look forward to working together as a team. - You have the federal police officer I certificate and have good police tactical and technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written expression in the German language. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You also have good IT and administrative knowledge, which you can use in a goal-oriented manner. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 99391 Philipp Kröbl, base manager Email: philipp.kroebl@sbb.ch Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Officier de police: à la base de la police des transports de Zurich, le 1er juillet 2025 ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Pour notre base de Zurich, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Nous travaillons également régulièrement avec d'autres corps de police et organismes partenaires, ce qui élargira votre réseau. Faites partie d'une équipe appréciée, dynamique et motivée qui veille à la sécurité et à l'ordre au-delà des frontières du canton. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant qu'officier de police des transports des CFF, vous et plus de 190 collègues veillez à la sécurité, à la tranquillité et à l'ordre dans les gares et dans les transports publics de différentes entreprises de transport. - Vous assurez une présence en uniforme et civile dans les moyens de transport, dans les gares et dans les locaux des entreprises de transport. - Vous contribuez à la protection et à la sécurité de nos voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Avec les interventions de la police, également en collaboration avec des organisations partenaires, vous assumez la responsabilité de la sécurité et de l'ordre. - Les défis passionnants incluent également les déploiements dans des trains événementiels et lors de grands événements dans le domaine opérationnel suisse. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes une personnalité orientée service, ouverte et gagnante, car vous êtes en contact quotidien avec nos clients. - Pour nous, le travail d'équipe est la clé du succès. Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et avez hâte de travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes titulaire du brevet de policier fédéral I et possédez de bonnes connaissances tactiques et techniques policières. - Vous vous caractérisez par une très bonne expression orale et écrite en langue allemande. La connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est un avantage. - Vous possédez également de bonnes connaissances informatiques et administratives, que vous pouvez utiliser de manière ciblée. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 01/2027 Brugg AG, 1 gennaio 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry into train driver: in passenger transport 01/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 01/2027 Brugg AG, January 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have basic knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103081 Marco Gosetti, Head of Training East Region Telephone +41 512 81 53 48 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans le transport de voyageurs 01/2027 Brugg AG, 1er janvier 2027, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Chief fitter in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you can initiate major changes and thus contribute to the success of SBB. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for your individual development. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy free ski slopes during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You will also receive time allowances. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - Together with the team, you carry out the demanding maintenance and renewal work as well as troubleshooting on our contact line systems. - You will be in charge of operations during construction, maintenance and repair work on the contact line systems. - In order to ensure the reliability and safety of the contact line systems economically, you lay our contact wires and support cables professionally. You will operate specialized equipment on the overhead line assembly machines on the respective vehicles with lifting, pulling and crane functions. - You lead employees professionally, lead work assignments and monitor the correct execution of the work and compliance with safety measures on the construction sites. This is what you bring with you. - You have a high level of resilience and a high level of safety awareness for this exciting challenge. We also place great value on the ability to work in a team and work independently. - You have a certificate of competence in the electrical or construction industry and have several years of experience in overhead line construction including switching authorization and expertise. - Good PC and user knowledge (MS Office, TUSP etc.) will make your work easier. You have already demonstrated your experience in planning (AVOR 3) and implementing construction sites. - You don't mind irregular working hours and on-call shifts and can communicate very well in German. Ideally, you have a driver's license of category A40 or higher, as well as a driver's license of category B. ## Your salary and benefits. Contremaître : dans la construction de voies ferrées en Suisse alémanique, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Une vie professionnelle quotidienne variée vous attend, caractérisée par un travail opérationnel ainsi que par l'exercice d'un rôle de direction. Vous assumerez une interface importante au sein des CFF dans le domaine d'activité de la succursale, dont le cœur est d'assurer la sécurité. Grâce à vous et à vos collaborateurs, les CFF peuvent transporter chaque jour plus d'un million de personnes d'un point A à un point B. Nous soutenons vos souhaits de développement ultérieur et proposons de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne pour votre carrière personnelle aux CFF. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, par exemple une AG de 2e classe gratuite et des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille. Vous pouvez trouver des informations plus intéressantes sur nos avantages sur notre site Web. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que contremaître, vous réalisez et gérez des travaux d'entretien ou de renouvellement ainsi que des travaux de superstructure et de génie civil dans le domaine routier. - Vous assurez la gestion technique des travaux et assurez un traitement optimal sur site ; soit pour l'ensemble du chantier, soit limité à un tronçon de voie (pour les grands chantiers). - Vous dirigerez les travaux sur plusieurs lieux de travail et prendrez en charge la gestion technique des chefs de chantier et des salariés. - Vous apportez un soutien à la préparation des travaux et au reporting. - En tant que responsable de la sécurité, vous prenez les mesures de sécurité et vérifiez leur conformité conformément à la politique de sécurité. - Vous gérez le service d'astreinte et intervenez sur site en cas d'incidents particuliers. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce rôle, vous disposez d'un apprentissage dans le secteur de la construction (par exemple constructeur de voies de circulation ou maçon) et d'une expérience dans le secteur routier. - Vous avez pu suivre une formation continue de contremaître (POS) ou de contremaître SBV et suivi une formation de contremaître SBV (VOS). - En tant que manager, vous vous caractérisez par votre bonne communication et votre capacité à travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes prêt à travailler selon des horaires irréguliers et à travailler à l'extérieur. - Vous disposez d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B., un permis de conduire valide de catégorie E (remorque) est un avantage. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence H, niveau d'allocation régionale 0. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. - Auch bei der Erkennung von Defekten und Mängeln bist du gefragt: kleinere Schäden behebst du selbst und meldest alles vorschriftsgemäss.
- Du gehst professionell mit Kundinnen und Kunden um und beantwortest Fragen kompetent.
- Du hältst Sicherheitsvorgaben stets ein und handelst verantwortungsbewusst.

- Als Teamplayer legst du Wert auf einen guten Zusammenhalt untereinander.

Grâce à des techniques modernes et des instructions de travail claires, vous travaillez de manière fiable, respectez les normes de qualité et respectez les règles de sécurité. Faites partie de notre équipe et contribuez chaque jour à la satisfaction de nos clients. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - En tant que joueur d'équipe, vous appréciez le bon esprit d'équipe. - Vous avez une attitude orientée client et possédez des compétences techniques. - Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle dans le secteur du nettoyage. - Un permis de conduire (au moins catégorie B) est requis pour ce poste. - Vous disposez de connaissances de base sur l'utilisation des outils numériques de travail tels que les smartphones. - Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau B1). ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. (charge de travail totale d'environ 10 jours par an)

## Ce que tu peux faire bouger :
- Réalisation d'examens (examen OFT ou procédure de qualification) conformément aux dispositions légales en vigueur
- Participation aux réunions d'experts ainsi qu'aux débriefings d'examens
- Collaboration étroite avec les experts en chef pour la mise en œuvre des mandats d'examen
- Participation aux journées de formation obligatoires à l'IFFP et à l'OFT
- Évaluation professionnelle des prestations des apprentis et contribution à la réussite de leur diplôme

## Ce que tu apportes :
- Tu es déjà expert d'examen VTE-OFT (EF/ISB : RhB ou CFF, resp. CFF Cargo) ou tu es disposé à acquérir les compétences requises. Nous t'accompagnerons dans le cadre d'une candidature séparée en tant qu'expert SEFI auprès du canton concerné.
- Permis de conduire valide, au minimum catégorie A40 VTE, y compris la préparation des trains EVU/ISB : RhB ou CFF, resp. CFF Cargo
- Connaissances approfondies du métier de spécialiste du transport ferroviaire
- Formation achevée (CFC) et au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle
- Sens aigu des responsabilités, fiabilité et discrétion
- Excellentes compétences en communication et esprit d'équipe
- Possibilité d'être affecté(e) jusqu'à 10 jours entre janvier et juin

Une activité variée et exigeante.

We look forward to your application by email: josephine.meier@login.org

Montatore: in catenaria trattore / macchinista di locomotiva: a Duliken, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Aziona le macchine speciali per la posa di linee di contatto e cavi, assumi compiti di sicurezza e supporta le squadre delle linee di contatto nei lavori di costruzione. Attendi con ansia lavori entusiasmanti e vari come artigiano e macchinista ed entra a far parte di un team di famiglia. In questo lavoro combini competenze tecniche con consapevolezza della sicurezza e talento organizzativo. Sei ambizioso? Con noi hai l'opportunità di svilupparti continuamente e acquisire nuove competenze. Consideri gli orari di lavoro irregolari e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per le tue attività flessibili nel tempo libero. Paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana. Riceverai anche generose indennità di tempo. Puoi trovare maggiori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi sul nostro sito web. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di installatore, tu e il tuo team eseguite tutti i lavori di manutenzione e rinnovamento con l'area principale del lavoro a catena sui sistemi di linee di contatto. - Il funzionamento del trattore a catenaria richiede un lavoro indipendente, ma viene sempre svolto in una squadra di due persone: sono quindi essenziali il lavoro di squadra e accordi chiari. - Possiedi la formazione adeguata come macchinista (macchinista) o la volontà di ottenerla. - Con le tue conoscenze e abilità manuali, puoi maneggiare diversi strumenti. La sicurezza è la tua massima priorità. - Non ti dispiace lavorare ad orari irregolari, soprattutto di notte e nei fine settimana. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei un giocatore di squadra con un forte senso di sicurezza e ti piace svilupparti continuamente a livello professionale e personale. - Hai la motivazione per seguire una formazione come macchinista nella categoria B100 o A. Durante la formazione a tempo pieno (4-9 mesi) sarai pagato al 100%. - Per questa posizione è necessario aver completato un apprendistato artigianale (EFZ). Possiedi anche una patente di guida di categoria B. - Ti piace lavorare fisicamente attivamente all'aria aperta. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo.
