descriptionByLocale.en: Fitter: in catenary tractor / locomotive driver: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Fitter: in catenary tractor / locomotive driver: in Dulliken, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Operate the special machines for laying contact lines and cables, take on safety tasks and support the contact line teams in the construction work. Look forward to exciting and varied jobs as a craftsman and train driver and become part of a family team. In this job, you combine technical skills with security awareness and organizational talent. Are you ambitious? With us you have the opportunity to continuously develop and acquire new skills. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage for your flexible leisure activities. We pay additional compensation for night and weekend work. You also receive generous time allowances. You can find more information about our benefits on our website. You can move that. - As a fitter, you and your team carry out all maintenance and renewal work with the main area of ​​chain work on contact line systems. - Operating the catenary tractor requires independent work, but is always carried out in a team of two - teamwork and clear agreements are therefore essential. - You have the appropriate training as a train driver (locomotive driver) or the willingness to obtain it. - With your know-how and manual skills, you can handle various tools. Safety is your top priority. - You don't mind working at irregular hours, especially at night and on weekends. This is what you bring with you. - You are a team player with a strong sense of security and enjoy continually developing yourself professionally and personally. - You have the motivation to be trained as a train driver in category B100 or A. During full-time training (4-9 months) you will be paid 100%. - For this position you need to have completed a craft apprenticeship (EFZ). You also have a driving license Category B. - You enjoy working physically actively outdoors. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Monteur : en caténaire conducteur de tracteur / locomotive : à Dulliken, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Opérer les machines spéciales pour la pose des lignes et câbles de contact, assumer les tâches de sécurité et soutenir les équipes des lignes de contact dans les travaux de construction. Attendez-vous à des emplois passionnants et variés en tant qu'artisan et conducteur de train et faites partie d'une équipe familiale. Dans ce poste, vous combinez des compétences techniques avec une sensibilisation à la sécurité et un talent organisationnel. Etes-vous ambitieux ? Avec nous, vous avez la possibilité de vous développer et d’acquérir continuellement de nouvelles compétences. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour vos loisirs flexibles. Nous versons une indemnité supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end. Vous bénéficiez également de généreuses allocations de temps. Vous pouvez trouver plus d’informations sur nos avantages sur notre site Web. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que monteur, vous et votre équipe réalisez tous les travaux de maintenance et de renouvellement avec pour principal domaine les travaux à la chaîne sur les systèmes de lignes de contact. - La conduite du tracteur à caténaire nécessite un travail indépendant, mais s'effectue toujours en équipe de deux - un travail d'équipe et des accords clairs sont donc essentiels. - Vous avez la formation appropriée de conducteur de train (conducteur de locomotive) ou la volonté de l'obtenir. - Grâce à votre savoir-faire et votre habileté manuelle, vous savez manipuler divers outils. La sécurité est votre priorité absolue. - Cela ne vous dérange pas de travailler à des horaires irréguliers, surtout la nuit et le week-end. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe doté d'un fort sentiment de sécurité et aimez vous développer continuellement sur le plan professionnel et personnel. - Vous avez la motivation pour suivre une formation de conducteur de train en catégorie B100 ou A. Lors d'une formation à temps plein (4-9 mois) vous serez rémunéré à 100%. - Pour ce poste, vous devez avoir effectué un apprentissage artisanal (EFZ). Vous disposez également d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B. - Vous aimez travailler physiquement activement en extérieur. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence D, niveau d'allocation régionale 0. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Lateral entry shunting engine driver & shunting manager in cat. A40 Hägendorf, from now on or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions and transport coordination in the Railway Technology Center (BTC) Hägendorf, the largest production and storage location for railway technology in Switzerland. You work from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 5 p.m. and occasionally take on on-call duty. Further training is also not neglected for individual professional development. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a train driver in the A40 category, you take responsibility for the safe, punctual and customer-oriented driving and maneuvering of SBB rail vehicles. - On a weekly basis, as a shunting manager or shunting attendant, you are responsible for the punctual delivery of rail cars and the formatting and dismantling of incoming and outgoing trains. - In this position, you will carry out the technical checks on the SBB rail vehicles and monitor the condition of the other rail cars so that they are available at all times. - Due to your safety awareness, it is natural for you to work in accordance with the applicable regulations. This is what you bring with you. - Reliability is what sets you apart and is reflected in punctuality, quality and safety awareness. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training with EFZ, ideally in the area of ​​traffic logistics or have already gained experience as a shunter or train driver in the past. - You have a valid BAV ID card for train drivers in category A40 according to VTE or are willing to obtain one. - Good knowledge of German (at least level B2) both spoken and written rounds off your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Quereinstieg Sicherheitswärter:in / Sicherheitschef
Winterthur, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Sicherheitswärter:in sorgst du dafür, dass Arbeiten im Gleisbereich mit Einhaltung der Sicherheitsmassnahmen sicher durchgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsalltag ist genauso abwechslungsreich wie deine Arbeitszeiten und die unterschiedlichen Einsatzorte, die du entlang der schönsten Bahnstrecken der Schweiz führst.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- In deiner Zuständigkeit fällt der Schutz des Personals sowie des Materials und der Geräte vor den Gefahren des Bahnbetriebes und der Bahnstromanlagen.
- Als Sicherheitswärter:in warnst du Kolleginnen und Kollegen auf der Bahnbaustelle vor herannahenden Zügen.
- Du bist verantwortlich für das Aufziehen sowie Durchführen eines Sicherheitsdispositivs und die direkte Kommunikation per Telefon oder Funk mit den zuständigen Stellen.
- Du informierst die Baustellenverantwortlichen über festgestellte aussergewöhnliche Vorkommnisse in deren Tätigkeitsbereich.
- Du bist viel unterwegs und übest diese Tätigkeit an verschiedenen Standorten deiner Region aus.
Hier mehr zum Berufsbild.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit bist du bereit selbständig, zuverlässig, teamfähig und offen, im Schichtbetrieb (Früh-, Tag-, Nacht und Wochenendeinsätze) zu arbeiten.
- Du bist körperlich und psychisch belastbar und zeichnest dich durch ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein aus.
- Idealerweise hast du eine Grundausbildung (EBA / EFZ) abgeschlossen oder bringst bereits Berufserfahrung im handwerklichen, logistischen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit. Dazu hast du die Ausbildung als Sicherheitswärter:in oder Sicherheitschef:in abgeschlossen oder bist bereit diese zu absolvieren.
- Im Umgang mit verschiedenen digitalen Arbeitsmitteln (iPad und iPhone) und Anwendungen bist du geschickt und bereit, dich stets weiterzubilden und dazuzulernen.
- Deine fliessenden Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache sind wünschenswert.
- Einen gültigen Fahrausweis der Kategorie B (Personenwagen mit manueller Handschaltung) und ein gutes Seh- und Hörvermögen runden dein Profil ab.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

descriptionByLocale.it: Guardia di sicurezza con ingresso laterale/capo della sicurezza 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Guardiano di sicurezza con ingresso laterale / capo della sicurezza Winterthur, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, ti assicuri che i lavori nell'area della pista siano svolti in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle misure di sicurezza. La vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è tanto varia quanto i vostri orari di lavoro e i diversi luoghi in cui viaggiate lungo le più belle tratte ferroviarie della Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - Sei responsabile della protezione del personale, dei materiali e delle attrezzature dai pericoli delle operazioni ferroviarie e dei sistemi di trazione. - In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, avverti i colleghi del cantiere ferroviario dell'avvicinarsi dei treni. - Sei responsabile della creazione e dell'implementazione di un sistema di sicurezza e della comunicazione diretta via telefono o radio con le autorità competenti. - Informare i responsabili del cantiere di eventuali incidenti insoliti rilevati nella loro area di attività. - Viaggi molto e svolgi questa attività in diverse località della tua regione. Maggiori informazioni sulla descrizione del lavoro qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei pronto a lavorare in modo indipendente, affidabile, come giocatore di squadra e apertamente, a turni (turni mattutini, diurni, notturni e nei fine settimana). - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e hai un forte senso di sicurezza. - Idealmente, hai completato la formazione di base (EBA / EFZ) o hai già esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in un settore comparabile. Hai completato la tua formazione come guardia di sicurezza o capo della sicurezza o sei pronto a completarla. - Sei abile nell'uso di vari strumenti di lavoro digitale (iPad e iPhone) e applicazioni e sei disposto a istruirti e apprendere continuamente. - Le tue competenze in tedesco fluente completano il tuo profilo. E' auspicabile la conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale. - Una patente di guida di categoria B valida (autovettura con cambio manuale) e una buona vista e udito completano il tuo profilo. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione definitiva entro un mese dal ricevimento della domanda Domanda Decisione definitiva entro un mese dal ricevimento della domanda Domande? Informazioni sul processo di candidatura Supporto Recruiting FFS Telefono + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu Domande frequenti sulla candidatura Alla posizione ID lavoro 102856 Andreas Müller, team leader Telefono +41 79 894 01 98 Purtroppo non è possibile prendere in considerazione candidature via e-mail. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry security guard / head of security 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry security guard / head of security Winterthur, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a safety guard, you ensure that work in the track area is carried out safely and in compliance with safety measures. Your everyday working life is just as varied as your working hours and the different locations you travel along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You are responsible for protecting staff, materials and equipment from the dangers of railway operations and traction power systems. - As a security guard, you warn colleagues at the railway construction site about approaching trains. - You are responsible for setting up and implementing a security system and communicating directly by telephone or radio with the responsible authorities. - You inform those responsible for the construction site about any unusual incidents that have been identified in their area of ​​activity. - You travel a lot and carry out this activity at different locations in your region. More about the job description here. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are prepared to work independently, reliably, as a team player and openly, in shifts (early morning, day, night and weekend shifts). - You are physically and mentally resilient and have a strong sense of security. - Ideally, you have completed basic training (EBA / EFZ) or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. You have completed your training as a security guard or head of security or are ready to complete it. - You are skilled at using various digital work tools (iPad and iPhone) and applications and are willing to continually educate yourself and learn. - Your fluent German skills round off your profile. Knowledge of a second national language is desirable. - A valid category B driving license (passenger car with manual transmission) and good eyesight and hearing complete your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102856 Andreas Müller, team leader Telephone +41 79 894 01 98 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Agent de sécurité à entrée latérale / responsable de la sécurité 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Agent de sécurité à entrée latérale / chef de la sécurité Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. En tant qu'agent de sécurité, vous veillez à ce que les travaux dans la zone de la voie soient effectués en toute sécurité et dans le respect des mesures de sécurité. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est aussi variée que vos horaires de travail et les différents lieux que vous parcourez le long des plus beaux itinéraires ferroviaires de Suisse. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous êtes responsable de la protection du personnel, du matériel et des équipements contre les dangers de l'exploitation ferroviaire et des systèmes de traction. - En tant qu'agent de sécurité, vous avertissez vos collègues sur le chantier ferroviaire de l'approche des trains. - Vous êtes responsable de la mise en place et de la mise en œuvre d'un système de sécurité et de communiquer directement par téléphone ou radio avec les autorités responsables. - Vous informez les responsables du chantier de tout incident inhabituel qui aurait été identifié dans leur domaine d'activité. - Vous voyagez beaucoup et exercez cette activité à différents endroits de votre région. En savoir plus sur la description de poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes prêt à travailler de manière indépendante, fiable, en équipe et ouvertement, par équipes (tôt le matin, de jour, de nuit et de fin de semaine). - Vous êtes résilient physiquement et mentalement et possédez un fort sentiment de sécurité. - Idéalement, vous avez suivi une formation de base (EBA/EFZ) ou possédez déjà une expérience professionnelle dans l'artisanat, la logistique ou un domaine comparable. Vous avez complété votre formation d'agent de sécurité ou de chef de sécurité ou êtes prêt à la compléter. - Vous maîtrisez l'utilisation de divers outils et applications de travail numériques (iPad et iPhone) et êtes disposé à vous former et à apprendre continuellement. -
• Vos compétences en allemand courant complètent votre profil. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Olten, May 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to 2 months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to 2 months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102713 Josip Aracic, team leader Telephone +41 79 586 17 10 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans un train de construction avec expérience manuelle Olten, le 1er mai 2026 ou sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Un programme de formation varié et rémunéré à temps plein de 9 mois vous attend. Vous complétez votre formation théorique à Olten ou à Zurich et acquérez votre première expérience pratique dans une gare de triage régionale. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels qu'une AG gratuite, des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages et vous pouvez trouver plus d'informations sur le poste ici. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de trains de chantier, vous contribuez grandement à assurer le renouvellement des voies (voies, graviers, etc.). - Vous effectuez et réalisez en toute autonomie des mouvements de manœuvres divers et complexes de trains jusqu'à un maximum de 100 km/h, les formez, les démontez et les préparez au voyage. - Afin d'assurer la logistique régionale, vous rédigez, demandez et commandez à temps les ordres de conduite et êtes responsable de l'approvisionnement des chantiers en matériel nécessaire. - Vous avez un haut niveau de responsabilité quant à la sécurité opérationnelle des trains de chantier. Le contrôle de la sécurité sur le lieu de travail et la création de rapports complètent les activités. - De plus, vous serez déployé en tant que conducteur de train pour des trains de chantier sur le chantier et vos compétences techniques seront requises. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes consciencieux, fiable, avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts de 24 heures. - Vous êtes physiquement et mentalement résilient et pouvez agir consciemment et correctement grâce à votre façon de travailler indépendante. - Vous disposez d'au moins deux années de formation professionnelle reconnue comprenant un certificat de compétence, idéalement dans le secteur de la construction et avec une expérience en construction de voies ou avez complété votre diplôme d'études secondaires. - La maîtrise de l'allemand écrit et parlé (niveau C1) est un prérequis. - Vous possédez un permis de conduire de catégorie B. - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Technician: in air conditioning systems for the SBB fleet in Olten, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Grab the opportunity for your next development step. Make your contribution to a good climate and become an air conditioning technician at SBB. An open-minded and committed team looks forward to seeing you. Today, more than 7,800 air conditioning units are installed in over 4,600 vehicles (trains, passenger cars and locomotives). This corresponds to a coverage of around 94 percent. In our own “Climate Competence Center” you have around 2,400 m2 available just for refurbishing the air conditioning units. Together you will develop solutions to the current challenges and implement them as a team. You can find out more about this profession on our website. And if you would like to take a look around this department, you can do so here. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As an air conditioning technician for the SBB fleet, you will actively work on repairing, overhauling and testing the air conditioning systems for our fleets. This ensures that our customers can travel with the highest possible comfort. You also make your contribution to a good climate, especially on the train. - You independently operate the air conditioning test devices to carry out input and output tests as well as diagnoses on the air conditioning devices. - You are responsible for the refrigeration interventions of the air conditioning units and carry them out with high efficiency and quality. - With your extensive know-how, you enjoy supporting the team. This is what you bring with you. - In our industry, teamwork is the key to success. You are an absolute team player with the ability to work in an interdisciplinary manner. - You act proactively and enjoy working independently. You systematically plan your next work steps in advance. Your solution-oriented way of thinking and acting makes your work easier in our dynamic and challenging environment. - Very good technical understanding and experience in remanufacturing in an industrial production company are an advantage. - You have basic training in the mechanical or electromechanical field with an EFZ qualification. Training such as refrigeration system fitter: in EFZ or similar is a great advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level F, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Ingegnere dell'automazione, elettrotecnico o installatore elettrico nel campo della tecnologia degli apparecchi di segnalazione Brugg AG, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti. I nostri vantaggi come assegni per figli, AG gratuita in 2a classe e viaggi all'estero scontati - anche per la famiglia - li trovate sul nostro sito web alla voce Prestazioni. Naturalmente anche queste ore lavorate verranno ricompensate di conseguenza. - Affinché tu possa svolgere con successo questa importante funzione, seguirai due anni di formazione interna part-time. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei una personalità tecnicamente esperta, indipendente e proattiva e sei sempre flessibile nel tuo modo di lavorare per i compiti coinvolti. - Per questa posizione è necessaria una formazione di base di elettrotecnica EFZ di 4 anni completata (ingegnere automatico, ingegnere elettrico, elettricista o professioni correlate). - Il presupposto per assumere l'incarico è un buon udito e una buona vista in modo da poter riconoscere importanti segnali acustici e visivi quando si lavora nell'area della pista. - Per questa posizione è necessaria la patente di guida di categoria B. Idealmente abitate nella regione di Brugg, in modo da poter essere sul posto entro circa 30 minuti durante il servizio di guardia. - Ci aspettiamo ottime competenze di tedesco orale e scritto (B2-C2). ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Automation engineer, electrical engineer or electrical installer in the field of interlocking technology 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Automation engineer, electrical engineer or electrical installer in the field of signal box technology Brugg AG, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We will train you to become a specialist for complex electrical interlocking systems. In this way, you can make a significant contribution to ensuring that our customers have highly available and secure signaling and automation systems at all times. In internal training courses you will be intensively and professionally prepared for your future role. There is also the opportunity to continually develop yourself and take on tasks with more responsibility. An ambitious and motivated team is looking forward to a new team member. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - In your role, you independently carry out construction and maintenance activities on the railway electrical systems, primarily indoors. - You will be actively involved in economically ensuring the reliability, availability and safety of the railway infrastructure systems. - You provide on-call duty to resolve faults in the complex systems and ensure their availability. - Depending on the respective project, you will work sporadically at night and on weekends. Of course, these hours worked will also be rewarded accordingly. - So that you can successfully carry out this important function, you will undergo two years of part-time internal training. We train you so that you can independently locate and resolve faults in the indoor systems. This is what you bring with you. - You are a technically savvy personality, independent and proactive and are always flexible in your way of working for the tasks involved. - For this position you need a completed 4-year basic electrical engineering training EFZ (automatic engineer, electrical engineer, electrician or related professions). - The prerequisite for taking up the position is good hearing and vision so that you can recognize important acoustic and visual signals when working in the track area. - For this position you need a category B driving license. Ideally, you live in the Brugg region so that you can be at the location within around 30 minutes during on-call duty. - We expect very good oral and written German skills (B2-C2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level F, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision approx. 6 weeks after receipt of application Application Final decision approx. 6 weeks after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 96797 Andreas Wölfli Telephone +41 79 503 91 26 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Ingénieur en automatisation, ingénieur électricien ou installateur électricien dans le domaine de la technologie des boîtes de signalisation Brugg AG, dès maintenant ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en attendre avec impatience. Nous vous formerons pour devenir un spécialiste des systèmes de verrouillage électriques complexes. De cette manière, vous pouvez contribuer de manière significative à garantir à nos clients des systèmes de signalisation et d’automatisation hautement disponibles et sécurisés à tout moment. Lors des formations internes, vous serez préparé de manière intensive et professionnelle à votre futur rôle. Il y a aussi la possibilité de se développer continuellement et d'assumer des tâches avec plus de responsabilités. Une équipe ambitieuse et motivée attend avec impatience un nouveau membre. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous. Vous trouverez nos avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Dans votre rôle, vous réalisez en toute autonomie des activités de construction et de maintenance sur les systèmes électriques ferroviaires, principalement en intérieur. - Vous participerez activement à assurer économiquement la fiabilité, la disponibilité et la sécurité des systèmes d'infrastructure ferroviaire. - Vous effectuez des astreintes pour résoudre les pannes des systèmes complexes et assurer leur disponibilité. - En fonction du projet concerné, vous travaillerez sporadiquement la nuit et le week-end. Bien entendu, ces heures travaillées seront également récompensées en conséquence. - Afin que vous puissiez exercer avec succès cette fonction importante, vous suivrez deux années de formation interne à temps partiel. Nous vous formons afin que vous puissiez localiser et résoudre de manière indépendante les défauts des systèmes intérieurs. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes une personnalité techniquement compétente, indépendante et proactive et êtes toujours flexible dans votre façon de travailler pour les tâches impliquées. - Pour ce poste, vous avez besoin d'une formation de base en électrotechnique de 4 ans complétée EFZ (ingénieur automatique, ingénieur électricien, électricien ou professions connexes). - La condition préalable pour prendre ce poste est une bonne audition et une bonne vision afin que vous puissiez reconnaître les signaux acoustiques et visuels importants lorsque vous travaillez dans la zone des voies. - Pour ce poste, vous avez besoin d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B. Idéalement, vous habitez dans la région de Brugg afin de pouvoir être sur place en 30 minutes environ en cas de garde. - Nous attendons de très bonnes compétences en allemand oral et écrit (B2-C2). ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Deine Stelle in der Welt der Mobilität

100%

## Das kannst du bewegen:
- Als Netzelektriker:in führst du zusammen mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen alle vorkommenden Unterhalts-, Erneuerungsarbeiten und Störungsbehebungen an Fahrleitungsanlagen aus.
- Im Laufe der Ausbildung lernst du die Hubarbeitsbühne zu bedienen.
- Unter Aufsicht einer sachverständigen Person führst du Schalthandlungen im Fahrleitungsnetz durch. Nach der Lehre bist du schaltberechtigt auf dem Netz der SBB Infrastruktur.
- Du bist bereit, zu unregelmässigen Zeiten zu arbeiten, insbesondere nachts und teilweise am Wochenende. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet. Zudem profitierst du von Zeitzuschlägen. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

## Das bringst du mit:
- Du bist mindestens 25 Jahre alt und hast Lust, einen neuen Beruf zu erlernen.
- Du bist handwerklich geschickt und verfügst idealerweise über praktische Erfahrungen im Fahrleitungs-, Freileitungs- oder Metallbau.
- Du bist gerne bei Wind und Wetter draussen.
- Netzelektriker:innen können sich aufeinander verlassen, denn Teamgeist ist genauso wichtig wie Sicherheitsvorschriften.
- Du hast ein gutes Seh- und Hörvermögen und keine Farbsinneinschränkung

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen:
Als Netzelektriker:in sorgst du täglich dafür, dass der Strom fliesst, damit unsere Kunden und Kundinnen pünktlich und sicher an ihr Ziel kommen. Du arbeitest mit deiner eigenen Körperkraft oder lässt modernste Maschinen diese Arbeit für Dich erledigen.
Deine Berufserfahrung ist und etwas wert. Je mehr relevante Berufserfahrung du mitbringst, desto höher wird dein Gehalt während und nach der Lehre sein: Im ersten Lehrjahr beträgt dein Gehalt 80%, im zweiten Lehrjahr bereits 90% und im dritten Lehrjahr 95% deines errechneten Lohns nach Abschluss der Lehre. Gerne machen wir dir im Rahmen des Erstgesprächs einen provisorischen Lohnvorschlag.
Deine dreijährige Ausbildung absolvierst du in einem Fahrleitungsteam der SBB Infrastruktur, angestellt bist du bei login, unserer Partnerin für Berufsbildung. Dabei wirst du von einem:r qualifizierten Berufsbildner:in begleitet. Parallel dazu besuchst du die Berufsschule.
Interessiert? Bei Fragen zur Ausbildung kannst du dich direkt an Rolf Bähni (+41 79 621 26 04) wenden. Du erreichst uns während unserer Bürozeiten von 08:00 bis 17:00 Uhr.
Der Bewerbungsprozess wird durch unsere Ausbildungspartnerin login Berufsbildung AG durchgeführt. Für Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess steht dir das Bewerbungszentrum von login gerne zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it: Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come elettricista di rete: in EFZ | login Formazione professionale - - - - - - - - La vostra posizione nel mondo della mobilità In qualità di partner educativo delle FFS, della BLS, della RhB, dell'Associazione dei trasporti pubblici (VöV) e di oltre 80 altre aziende legate alla mobilità e alla mobilità, login Berufsbildung AG organizza tirocini professionali, stage e perfezionamento orientati al mercato per circa 2.100 apprendisti in oltre 35 professioni diverse. Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come elettricista di rete: in EFZ 100% ## Ecco cosa puoi fare: - Come elettricista di rete, tu e i tuoi colleghi eseguite tutti i lavori di manutenzione, rinnovamento e risoluzione dei problemi sugli impianti di linee aeree. - Nel corso della formazione imparerai a utilizzare la piattaforma di lavoro aereo. - Sotto la supervisione di un esperto, effettuate operazioni di commutazione nella rete della linea di contatto. Dopo il tirocinio sarete autorizzati a utilizzare la rete Infrastruttura FFS. - Sei disposto a lavorare ad orari irregolari, soprattutto di notte e talvolta nei fine settimana. Puoi organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile durante la settimana. Il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana viene retribuito in aggiunta. Beneficerai anche di bonus di tempo. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. ## Ecco cosa porti con te: - Hai almeno 25 anni e vorresti imparare una nuova professione. - Possiedi competenze tecniche e possibilmente hai esperienza pratica nella catenaria, nella linea aerea o nella costruzione metallica. - Ti piace stare fuori con il vento e le intemperie. - Gli elettricisti di rete possono contare l'uno sull'altro perché lo spirito di squadra è importante tanto quanto le norme di sicurezza. - Hai una buona vista e udito e nessun disturbo nella visione dei colori ## Ecco cosa puoi aspettarti: come elettricista di rete, ti assicuri che la corrente elettrica circoli ogni giorno in modo che i nostri clienti arrivino a destinazione in tempo e in sicurezza. Lavori con la tua forza fisica o lasci che le macchine più moderne facciano il lavoro per te. La tua esperienza professionale vale qualcosa. Più esperienza professionale hai, più alto sarà il tuo stipendio durante e dopo il tuo apprendistato: nel primo anno di apprendistato il tuo stipendio sarà dell'80%, nel secondo anno di apprendistato sarà del 90% e nel terzo anno di apprendistato sarà del 95% dello stipendio calcolato dopo aver completato l'apprendistato. Saremo lieti di farti una proposta di stipendio provvisorio durante la consultazione iniziale. Completerai la tua formazione triennale in un team di gestione dei contatti presso FFS Infrastruttura e sarai assunto da login, il nostro partner per la formazione professionale. Sarai accompagnato da un formatore professionale qualificato. Allo stesso tempo, frequenti la scuola professionale. Interessato? In caso di domande sulla formazione potete contattare direttamente Rolf Bähni (41 79 621 26 04). Potete contattarci nei nostri orari d'ufficio dalle 8:00 alle 17:00. Il processo di candidatura viene eseguito dal nostro partner di formazione login Berufsbildung AG. Se hai domande sul processo di richiesta, il centro richieste di accesso sarà felice di aiutarti. login Centro Richiesta 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org Saremo lieti di accettare la tua richiesta tramite il nostro strumento di richiesta.
descriptionByLocale.en: Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a network electrician: in EFZ | login Vocational Training - - - - - - - - Your position in the world of mobility As an educational partner of the SBB, BLS, RhB, the Public Transport Association (VöV) and over 80 other mobility and mobility-related companies, login Berufsbildung AG organizes market-oriented vocational apprenticeships, internships and further training for around 2,100 trainees in over 35 different professions. Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a network electrician: in EFZ 100% ## This is what you can do: - As a network electrician, you and your colleagues carry out all maintenance, renewal work and troubleshooting on overhead line systems. - During the course of your training you will learn to operate the aerial work platform. - Under the supervision of an expert, you carry out switching operations in the contact line network. After your apprenticeship, you will be authorized to use the SBB Infrastructure network. - You are willing to work at irregular hours, especially at night and sometimes on weekends. You can organize your free time more flexibly during the week. Night and weekend work is paid additionally. You also benefit from time bonuses. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. ## This is what you bring with you: - You are at least 25 years old and would like to learn a new profession. - You are technically skilled and ideally have practical experience in catenary, overhead line or metal construction. - You like being outside in wind and weather. - Network electricians can rely on each other because team spirit is just as important as safety regulations. - You have good eyesight and hearing and no color vision impairment ## This is what you can look forward to: As a network electrician, you ensure that the electricity flows every day so that our customers reach their destination on time and safely. You work with your own physical strength or let the most modern machines do the work for you. Your professional experience is worth something. The more relevant professional experience you have, the higher your salary will be during and after your apprenticeship: in the first year of your apprenticeship your salary will be 80%, in the second year of your apprenticeship it will be 90% and in the third year of your apprenticeship it will be 95% of your calculated salary after completing your apprenticeship. We would be happy to make you a provisional salary suggestion during the initial consultation. You will complete your three-year training in a contact management team at SBB Infrastructure, and you will be employed by login, our partner for vocational training. You will be accompanied by a qualified vocational trainer. At the same time, you attend vocational school. Interested? If you have any questions about training, you can contact Rolf Bähni (41 79 621 26 04) directly. You can reach us during our office hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The application process is carried out by our training partner login Berufsbildung AG. If you have any questions about the application process, the login application center will be happy to help you. login Application Center 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org We will be happy to accept your application via our application tool.

Deine Stelle in der Welt der Mobilität
Als Bildungspartnerin der SBB, BLS, RhB, des Verbandes öffentlicher Verkehr (VöV) und über 80 weiteren Mobilitäts- und mobilitätsnahen Unternehmen organisiert login Berufsbildung AG marktorientierte Berufslehren, Praktika und Weiterbildungen für rund 2100 Auszubildenden in über 35 verschiedenen Berufen.
Jetzt bezahlte Erwachsenenlehre starten als Gleisbauer:in EFZ
100%

## Das kannst du bewegen:
- Als Gleisbauer:in führst du zusammen mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen alle vorkommenden Unterhaltsarbeiten und Störungsbehebungen an Gleis und Weichenanlagen aus.
- Sämtliche Gleisumbauten und Gleisneubauten führst du im Team aus. Dank guter Planung und einer sorgfältigen Arbeitsvorbereitung gelingt dies millimetergenau.
- Unterstützt von modernsten Gleisbaumaschinen baust Du das Schienennetz weiter aus, kontrollierst es mit präzisen Messgeräten und hältst es mit Kleinmaschinen und Geräten instand.
- Du bist bereit, zu unregelmässigen Zeiten zu arbeiten, insbesondere nachts und teilweise am Wochenende. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns aber sowohl finanziell als auch zeitlich zusätzlich vergütet. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten und hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

## Das bringst du mit:
- Du bist mindestens 25 Jahre alt und hast Lust, einen neuen Beruf zu erlernen.
- Du bist handwerklich geschickt.
- Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und gerne bei Wind und Wetter draussen.
- Gleisbauer:innen können sich aufeinander verlassen, denn Teamgeist ist genauso wichtig wie Sicherheitsvorschriften.
- Du hast ein gutes Seh- und Hörvermögen und keine Farbsinneinschränkung

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen:
In deinem Beruf als Gleisbauer:in trägst Du massgeblich dazu bei, dass der Zugverkehr in der Schweiz pünktlich und sicher verkehrt. Du arbeitest mit deiner eigenen Körperkraft oder lässt modernste Maschinen diese Arbeit für dich erledigen.
Deine Berufserfahrung ist uns etwas wert. Je mehr relevante Berufserfahrung Du mitbringst, desto höher wird dein Gehalt während und nach der Lehre sein: Im ersten Lehrjahr beträgt dein Gehalt 80%, im zweiten Lehrjahr bereits 90% und im dritten Lehrjahr 95% deines errechneten Lohns nach Abschluss der Lehre. Gerne machen wir Dir im Rahmen des Erstgesprächs einen provisorischen Lohnvorschlag.
Im ersten Lehrjahr der dreijährigen Ausbildung absolvierst Du die Basisausbildung bei login. Danach wechselst Du für das zweite und dritte Lehrjahr zur SBB. Dabei wirst Du von einem:r qualifizierten Berufsbildner:in begleitet. Parallel dazu besuchst Du die Berufsschule.
Interessiert? Bei Fragen zur Ausbildung kannst du dich direkt an Andreas Stähli (+41 79 751 93 49) wenden. Du erreichst uns während unserer Bürozeiten von 08:00 bis 17:00 Uhr.
Der Bewerbungsprozess wird durch unsere Ausbildungspartnerin login Berufsbildung AG durchgeführt. Für Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess steht dir das Bewerbungszentrum von login gerne zur Verfügung.
login Bewerbungszentrum
0848 822 422
bewerbung@login.org
Deine Bewerbung nehmen wir gerne über unser Bewerbungstool entgegen.

descriptionByLocale.it: Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come montatore di piste EFZ | login Formazione professionale - - - - - - - - La vostra posizione nel mondo della mobilità In qualità di partner educativo delle FFS, della BLS, della RhB, dell'Associazione dei trasporti pubblici (VöV) e di oltre 80 altre aziende legate alla mobilità e alla mobilità, login Berufsbildung AG organizza tirocini professionali, stage e perfezionamento orientati al mercato per circa 2.100 apprendisti in oltre 35 professioni diverse. Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come montatore di binari EFZ 100% ## Ecco cosa puoi fare: - Come montatore di binari, tu e i tuoi colleghi eseguite tutti i lavori di manutenzione e risoluzione dei problemi sui binari e sui sistemi di scambio. - Eseguite tutte le conversioni dei binari e la costruzione di nuovi binari come una squadra. Grazie ad una buona pianificazione e ad un'attenta preparazione del lavoro, ciò può essere ottenuto con precisione millimetrica. - Supportato dalle più moderne macchine per la costruzione dei binari, continuerai ad espandere la rete ferroviaria, a controllarla con dispositivi di misurazione precisi e a mantenerla con piccole macchine e dispositivi. - Sei disposto a lavorare ad orari irregolari, soprattutto di notte e talvolta nei fine settimana. Tuttavia, paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, sia in termini finanziari che in termini di tempo. Puoi però organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile durante la settimana e avere più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. ## Ecco cosa porti con te: - Hai almeno 25 anni e vorresti imparare una nuova professione. - Sei abile nell'artigianato. - Sei un vero giocatore di squadra e ti piace stare fuori con vento e intemperie. - I costruttori di piste possono contare l'uno sull'altro perché lo spirito di squadra è importante tanto quanto le norme di sicurezza. - Hai una buona vista e un buon udito e non hai problemi alla visione dei colori ## Puoi aspettarti questo: nel tuo lavoro di costruttore di binari contribuirai in modo significativo a garantire che l'offerta ferroviaria in Svizzera funzioni in modo puntuale e sicuro. Lavori con la tua forza fisica o lasci che le macchine più moderne facciano il lavoro per te. Per noi la tua esperienza professionale vale qualcosa. Più esperienza professionale hai, più alto sarà il tuo stipendio durante e dopo il tuo apprendistato: nel primo anno di apprendistato il tuo stipendio sarà dell'80%, nel secondo anno di apprendistato sarà del 90% e nel terzo anno di apprendistato sarà del 95% dello stipendio calcolato dopo aver completato l'apprendistato. Saremo lieti di farti una proposta di stipendio provvisorio durante la consultazione iniziale. Nel primo anno del percorso formativo triennale completate la formazione di base al momento del login. Successivamente passerai alle FFS per il secondo e il terzo anno di tirocinio. Sarai accompagnato da un formatore professionale qualificato. Allo stesso tempo, frequenterai la scuola professionale. Interessato? Se avete domande sulla formazione potete contattare direttamente Andreas Stähli (41 79 751 93 49). Potete contattarci nei nostri orari d'ufficio dalle 8:00 alle 17:00. Il processo di candidatura viene eseguito dal nostro partner di formazione login Berufsbildung AG. Se hai domande sul processo di richiesta, il centro richieste di accesso sarà felice di aiutarti. login Centro Richiesta 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org Saremo lieti di accettare la tua richiesta tramite il nostro strumento di richiesta.
descriptionByLocale.en: Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a track fitter EFZ | login Vocational Training - - - - - - - - Your position in the world of mobility As an educational partner of the SBB, BLS, RhB, the Public Transport Association (VöV) and over 80 other mobility and mobility-related companies, login Berufsbildung AG organizes market-oriented vocational apprenticeships, internships and further training for around 2,100 trainees in over 35 different professions. Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a track fitter EFZ 100% ## This is what you can do: - As a track fitter, you and your colleagues carry out all maintenance work and troubleshooting on the track and switch systems. - You carry out all track conversions and new track construction as a team. Thanks to good planning and careful work preparation, this can be achieved with millimeter precision. - Supported by the most modern track construction machines, you will continue to expand the rail network, control it with precise measuring devices and maintain it with small machines and devices. - You are willing to work at irregular hours, especially at night and sometimes on weekends. However, we pay additional compensation for night and weekend work, both financially and in terms of time. However, you can organize your free time more flexibly during the week and have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. ## This is what you bring with you: - You are at least 25 years old and would like to learn a new profession. - You are skilled at craftsmanship. - You are a real team player and enjoy being outside in wind and weather. - Track builders can rely on each other because team spirit is just as important as safety regulations. - You have good eyesight and hearing and no color vision impairment ## You can look forward to this: In your job as a track builder, you will make a significant contribution to ensuring that train services in Switzerland run punctually and safely. You work with your own physical strength or let the most modern machines do the work for you. Your professional experience is worth something to us. The more relevant professional experience you have, the higher your salary will be during and after your apprenticeship: in the first year of your apprenticeship your salary will be 80%, in the second year of your apprenticeship it will be 90% and in the third year of your apprenticeship it will be 95% of your calculated salary after completing your apprenticeship. We would be happy to make you a provisional salary suggestion during the initial consultation. In the first year of the three-year training course, you complete the basic training at login. You will then move to SBB for the second and third year of your apprenticeship. You will be accompanied by a qualified vocational trainer. At the same time, you will attend vocational school. Interested? If you have any questions about training, you can contact Andreas Stähli directly (41 79 751 93 49). You can reach us during our office hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The application process is carried out by our training partner login Berufsbildung AG. If you have any questions about the application process, the login application center will be happy to help you. login Application Center 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org We will be happy to accept your application via our application tool.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Commencez dès maintenant votre apprentissage rémunéré pour adultes en tant que monteur de chenilles EFZ | login Formation professionnelle - - - - - - - - Votre position dans le monde de la mobilité En tant que partenaire pédagogique des CFF, du BLS, des RhB, de la Fédération des transports publics (VöV) et de plus de 80 autres entreprises de mobilité et liées à la mobilité, login Berufsbildung AG organise des apprentissages professionnels, des stages et des formations continues adaptés au marché pour environ 2 100 apprenants dans plus de 35 professions différentes. Commencez dès maintenant votre apprentissage rémunéré pour adultes en tant que monteur de voies EFZ 100% ## Voici ce que vous pouvez faire : - En tant que monteur de voies, vous et vos collègues effectuez tous les travaux de maintenance et de dépannage sur les systèmes de voie et d'aiguillage. - Vous effectuez toutes les conversions de voies et la construction de nouvelles voies en équipe. Grâce à une bonne planification et à une préparation minutieuse du travail, cela peut être réalisé avec une précision millimétrique. - Soutenu par les machines de construction de voies les plus modernes, vous continuerez à étendre le réseau ferroviaire, à le contrôler avec des appareils de mesure précis et à l'entretenir avec de petites machines et appareils. - Vous êtes disposé à travailler à des horaires irréguliers, notamment la nuit et parfois le week-end. Cependant, nous versons une compensation supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, tant financièrement qu'en termes de temps. Cependant, vous pouvez organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible pendant la semaine et disposer de plus de temps libre que les salariés sans équipe de nuit et de week-end. ## Voici ce que vous apportez avec vous : - Vous avez au moins 25 ans et souhaitez apprendre un nouveau métier. - Vous êtes doué en artisanat. - Vous êtes un véritable joueur d'équipe et aimez être dehors par vent et intempéries. - Les constructeurs de circuits peuvent compter les uns sur les autres car l'esprit d'équipe est tout aussi important que les règles de sécurité. - Vous avez une bonne vue et une bonne audition et aucune déficience de la vision des couleurs ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir : dans votre travail de constructeur de voies, vous contribuerez de manière significative à garantir que les services ferroviaires en Suisse fonctionnent à temps et en toute sécurité. Vous travaillez avec votre propre force physique ou laissez les machines les plus modernes faire le travail à votre place. Votre expérience professionnelle vaut quelque chose pour nous. Plus votre expérience professionnelle est pertinente, plus votre salaire sera élevé pendant et après votre apprentissage : la première année de votre apprentissage, votre salaire sera de 80 %, la deuxième année de votre apprentissage, il sera de 90 % et la troisième année de votre apprentissage, il sera de 95 % de votre salaire calculé après avoir terminé votre apprentissage. Nous serions heureux de vous faire une proposition salariale provisoire lors de la première consultation. Au cours de la première année de la formation de trois ans, vous suivez la formation de base lors de la connexion. Vous passerez ensuite aux CFF pour la deuxième et la troisième année de votre apprentissage. Vous serez accompagné par un formateur professionnel diplômé. En parallèle, vous fréquenterez une école professionnelle. Intéressé? Si vous avez des questions concernant la formation, vous pouvez contacter directement Andreas Stähli (41 79 751 93 49). Vous pouvez nous joindre pendant nos heures de bureau de 8h à 17h. Le processus de candidature est effectué par notre partenaire de formation login Berufsbildung AG. Si vous avez des questions sur le processus de candidature, le centre de candidature de connexion se fera un plaisir de vous aider. login Application Center 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org Nous serons heureux d'accepter votre candidature via notre outil de candidature.

-
-

Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Polizist:in Transportpolizei
Stützpunkt St. Gallen, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Für unseren Stützpunkt in St. Gallen suchen wir engagierte und motivierte Polizist:innen, die sich einer spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Stelle widmen möchten. Bei uns steht nicht die Büroarbeit im Vordergrund, sondern die bürgernahe Polizeiarbeit am Puls des Geschehens im öffentlichen Verkehr mit einem klaren Fokus auf die sicherheitspolizeilichen Aufgaben. Zudem arbeiten wir regelmässig mit anderen Polizeikräften und Partnerorganisationen zusammen, was dein Netzwerk erweitern wird. Werde Teil eines wertschätzenden, dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das über die Kantonsgrenzen hinaus für Sicherheit und Ordnung sorgt.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Unsere weiteren Benefits wie Kinderzulagen, kostenloses 2. Klasse GA und vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter «Benefits».
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Polizist:in der Transportpolizei SBB sorgst du national mit über 190 Kollegen:innen in den Bahnhöfen und in den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln verschiedener Transportunternehmen für Sicherheit, Ruhe und Ordnung.
- Du leistest uniformierte und auch zivile Präsenz in Transportmitteln, in Bahnhöfen und auf dem Areal der Transportunternehmen.
- Dabei trägst du zum Schutz und zur Sicherheit unserer Reisenden und des Personals des öffentlichen Verkehrs bei.
- Mit polizeilichen Interventionen, auch zusammen mit Partnerorganisationen, übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Sicherheit und Ordnung.
- Zu den spannenden Herausforderungen gehören auch Einsätze in Eventzügen und an Grossanlässen im Einsatzgebiet Schweiz.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist eine dienstleistungsorientierte, offene und gewinnende Persönlichkeit, da du täglich im Kontakt mit unseren Kunden:innen stehst.
- Bei uns ist Teamwork der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und freust dich auf die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
- Du verfügst über den eidgenössischen Fachausweis Polizist:in I und bringst gute polizeitaktische und -technische Kenntnisse mit.
- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksweise in der deutschen Sprache zeichnen dich aus. Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache sind von Vorteil.
- Gute IT- und administrative Kenntnisse, welche du zielorientiert einsetzen kannst, bringst du ebenfalls mit.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau H, Regionalzulage Stufe 0. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Officier de police à la base de la police des transports de Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Pour notre nouveau bureau de Winterthour, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Faites partie d'une équipe appréciée, dynamique et motivée qui veille à la sécurité et à l'ordre au-delà des frontières du canton. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der Intervention SBB bist du rund um die Uhr bereit für den Ernstfall. Über 80 moderne Einsatzfahrzeuge auf Schienen und Strassen sind dabei im Einsatz. Was macht diesen Beruf einzigartig? Du bist Bahnspezialist:in, Lokführer:in und Feuerwehrperson in einem. Du kümmerst dich bei einem Ereignis um die Sicherheit unserer Kundinnen und Kunden und trägst dazu bei, dass der Bahnverkehr schnellstmöglich wieder normal läuft. Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Im Alarmfall sowie bei Übungen rückst du als Lokführer:in mit dem Lösch- und Rettungszug mit deinem Team aus und sorgst für die Sicherheit unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.
- Bei Zwischenfällen, welche den Bahnverkehr beeinträchtigen, bist du mitverantwortlich für den Schutz von Menschen, Tieren, Umwelt und Bahninfrastruktur.

Lateral entry specialist: in railway rescue Ostermundigen, August 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. With SBB Intervention, you are ready around the clock in case of an emergency. Over 80 modern emergency vehicles are in use on rails and roads. What makes this job unique? You are a railway specialist, train driver and firefighter all in one. You will ensure the safety of our customers during an event and help ensure that rail traffic returns to normal as quickly as possible. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can move that. - In the event of an alarm or during exercises, as a train driver you will be deployed with your team in the fire and rescue train and ensure the safety of our customers. - In the event of incidents that affect rail traffic, you are jointly responsible for the protection of people, animals, the environment and rail infrastructure. - On site you ensure the safety of all travelers, fight fires on and next to the tracks, provide oil and chemical protection and technical assistance. The use of drones helps to quickly assess the situation. - You regularly train the various work processes and techniques to ensure smooth event management at all times. You will work 24-hour shifts from Monday to Friday and will be on call at the weekend. Irregular working hours are the rule for us. But you can enjoy free ski slopes during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. Find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your high sense of responsibility and security, you understand the dependencies and effects on your team and your work. What counts for us is togetherness and community in a team that you can rely on at any time. This means that you enjoy working independently and are physically and mentally resilient. - You have completed a vocational apprenticeship with a federal certificate of proficiency (EFZ). You already have a driving license for locomotives in category B100 or are willing to complete the relevant internal paid training. - You have a category B and ideally also category C1 118 driving license. - You are suitable for respiratory protection and have experience as a firefighter. - You are fluent in the German language (orally and in writing) and you are ready to complete a French diploma at level A1. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life.
