descriptionByLocale.en: Shunting specialist: in team station Ai40 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting specialist: in team station Ai40 Bern, by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You will also receive varied and paid training in the marshalling yard. There are also various further training opportunities available to you, such as training to become a shunting engine driver. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will also receive a time allowance of between 10 and 30%. This means that you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates in 2026: - August 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - As a shunting specialist, you will help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time by preparing freight trains for their journey. - You take over the cars, carry out safety checks and prepare the train for the next journey through complex shunting movements. - You record the necessary data for train routing using personal, modern IT devices (e.g. tablet). - By delivering and dropping off the cars at the customer's site in a timely manner, you have direct customer contact on a daily basis. You receive their feedback and, if necessary, forward it to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Ideally, you have completed basic training or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - In German (level C1) until you are fluent in speech and writing. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. • Cerchiamo diversi agenti di polizia nell'ambito di un progetto di costruzione presso la base strategicamente importante di Olten. Rafforzerai il team esistente e garantirai che le persone si sentano sicure sui trasporti pubblici attraverso la polizia di prossimità. Invece della routine amministrativa, l’attenzione si concentra su operazioni vicine all’azione, oltre i confini cantonali e integrate in un team forte e riconoscente. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Grazie ai tempi di riposo chiaramente regolamentati e ai pochi turni notturni, presso la Polizia dei trasporti FFS è possibile conciliare facilmente lavoro e vita privata. Puoi scegliere il tuo carico di lavoro in modo flessibile tra il 40 e il 100%, non è necessario avere un luogo di residenza. descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 50-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer: in Transport Police Olten, from now on or by appointment, 50-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We are looking for several police officers as part of a construction project at the strategically important base in Olten. You will strengthen the existing team and ensure that people feel safe on public transport through community policing. Instead of administrative routine, the focus is on operations close to the action – across cantonal borders and embedded in a strong, appreciative team. Attractive working conditions are important to us – even with irregular working hours. Thanks to clearly regulated rest times and only a few night shifts, work and private life can be easily reconciled at the SBB Transport Police. You can choose your workload flexibly between 40-100%, there is no requirement to have a place of residence. Night and weekend work is paid additionally, e.g. B. with CHF 16 per hour for Sunday work as well as time surcharges of 10-30% for night shifts. Further benefits such as free GA 2nd class, child allowances and discounted travel at home and abroad – you can also find them for your family under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you and over 200 colleagues throughout Switzerland ensure safety, peace and order in train stations and public transport from various transport companies. - Your focus is on uniformed patrol services in means of transport, train stations and on the areas of transport companies. - In your role, you make a significant contribution to the safety of travelers and staff in public transport. - During police interventions, you will be responsible for the team and in collaboration with partner organizations - even at major events. - You work in a situation-oriented manner and always have your finger on the pulse of what is happening in public transport. - You will be actively involved in building the team and actively shaping it. This is what you bring with you. - As a team player, you value working together as equals and actively contribute to the team. - You appear open, respectful and professional and meet customers with a strong understanding of service. - You have the federal Police officer certificate I as well as in-depth police tactical and technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written German skills; Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You use digital tools safely and responsibly and use them in a targeted manner in everyday operations. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102278 Michael Bigler, Head of Olten Support Telephone +41 79 876 95 69 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nelle manovre Biel/Bienne, previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Circa 14'000 collaboratori del trasporto passeggeri garantiscono che gli oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti delle FFS che trasportiamo ogni giorno abbiano un facile accesso ai trasporti pubblici e viaggino da A a B in modo sicuro e puntuale. In quanto gruppo professionale centrale, il personale di manovra fornisce un contributo fondamentale a questo scopo. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, nel quale ti muoverai alle FFS insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, oltre a una formazione varia e retribuita. Hai anche diverse opportunità di formazione interna. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni verranno applicati supplementi orari compresi tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Possibili date di inizio nel 2026: - 1 agosto 2026 - 1 ottobre 2026 Puoi fare la differenza. - Prepari i treni passeggeri per il loro viaggio e li sposti al punto di partenza corretto dentro e intorno alla stazione (fino a un massimo di 40 km/h). - Metti insieme i treni, separa i singoli vagoni e assicurati che tutto sia al posto giusto. - Prepari il treno per la partenza, controlli le funzioni più importanti ed effettui i controlli dei freni. - Durante il tuo lavoro mantieni una visione d'insieme e ti assicuri che tutti i processi si svolgano in modo sicuro e senza intoppi. - Puoi riparare tu stesso i problemi minori o segnalarli all'ufficio competente. Puoi scoprire di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei attento, concentrato e fisicamente resistente per completare con successo questo lavoro impegnativo in turni di 24 ore. Ti piace anche lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Poiché tutte le istruzioni e la documentazione sono elettroniche, potrai orientarti rapidamente utilizzando gli strumenti digitali. - Hai completato l'istruzione di base (almeno EBA) e hai già esperienza pratica, idealmente in un ambiente artigianale o logistico. - Hai una buona conoscenza parlata e scritta della lingua tedesca (livello B2). - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde) ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefit. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito E, livello di indennità regionale Nessuna indennità regionale. Maggiori informazioni su retribuzione e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in shunting 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Biel/Bienne, by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates in 2026: - August 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 100933 Gilles Demierre Telephone +41 51 224 22 63 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in shunting 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Brig, by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible training starts in 2026: - May 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 100932 Rémy Tolck, Deputy Training Telephone +41 512 81 98 60 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : à Brigue, sur rendez-vous, 60 à 100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. Près de 14 000 collaborateurs du secteur du transport de voyageurs veillent à ce que plus de 1,4 million de clients CFF que nous transportons chaque jour puissent accéder facilement aux transports publics et se rendre d'un point A à un point B en toute sécurité et à temps. En tant que groupe professionnel central, le personnel de manœuvre y apporte une contribution essentielle. Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend, dans lequel vous évoluerez aux CFF avec vos coéquipiers, ainsi que des formations variées et rémunérées. Vous disposez également de diverses opportunités de formation interne. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous recevrez des majorations de temps supplémentaires comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le profil de poste ici. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Fachspezialist:in Einsatzleitzentrale der Transportpolizei bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kundschaft und das Zugpersonal. Mit deinem Einsatz trägst du wesentlich zur Sicherheit in Zügen und Bahnhöfen bei. Jeden Tag vertrauen dir tausende Reisende und Mitarbeitende – du bist ein zentraler Faktor für Ruhe, Ordnung und ein sicheres Reiseerlebnis.

- Als erste Anlaufstelle in der Einsatzleitzentrale nimmst du Notrufe und Meldungen von Kundschaft und Zugpersonal entgegen, beurteilst die Lage und leitest rasch und zuverlässig die nötigen Schritte ein.

- Gemeinsam mit über 190 Kolleg:innen in den Bahnhöfen und in den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln leistest du deinen Beitrag für Sicherheit, Ruhe und Ordnung.

Das bringst du mit.
- Dank deiner dienstleistungsorientierten, offenen und gewinnenden Art begegnest du unserer Kundschaft und dem Zugpersonal stets freundlich und professionell.

- Deine guten IT- und Administrationskenntnisse setzt du zielgerichtet im Einsatzalltag ein.
- Du verfügst idealerweise über den eidgenössischen Fachausweis Polizist:in I und hast fundierte polizeitaktische und – technische Kenntnisse, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in einer Einsatzzentrale.
- Du kommunizierst klar und sicher in Deutsch; gute Kenntnisse in Französisch (Level B1) sind zwingend und weitere Sprachen wie Italienisch oder Englisch ein Plus.

Specialist: in the operations control center of the Bern Transport Police, from now on or by appointment, 40-100%, Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a specialist in the transport police operations control center, you are the first point of contact for our customers and the train staff. With your efforts, you make a significant contribution to safety on trains and stations. Thousands of travelers and employees trust you every day - you are a central factor for peace, order and a safe travel experience. You can move that. - As the first point of contact in the operations control center, you receive emergency calls and reports from customers and train staff, assess the situation and take the necessary steps quickly and reliably. - You support our colleagues at the front by professionally accompanying and coordinating operations throughout Switzerland and maintaining an overview of the situation at all times. - Together with over 190 colleagues in the train stations and on public transport, you make your contribution to safety, peace and order. - In close cooperation with our partner organizations, you will take on responsibility in the security network and help ensure that our customers feel well protected and safe at all times. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your service-oriented, open and winning manner, you always treat our customers and train staff in a friendly and professional manner. - Teamwork is important to you – you enjoy working with others and are actively involved in the team. - You will use your good IT and administration skills in a targeted manner in everyday operations. - Ideally, you have the federal police officer I certificate and have in-depth police tactical and technical knowledge, ideally supplemented by experience in an operations center. - You communicate clearly and confidently in German; Good knowledge of French (Level B1) is mandatory and other languages ​​such as Italian or English are a plus. ## Your salary and your benefits. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que premier point de contact au centre de contrôle des opérations, vous recevez les appels d'urgence et les rapports des clients et formez le personnel, évaluez la situation et prenez les mesures nécessaires de manière rapide et fiable. - Vous soutenez nos collègues du front en accompagnant et en coordonnant professionnellement les opérations dans toute la Suisse et en gardant à tout moment une vue d'ensemble de la situation. - Avec plus de 190 collègues dans les gares et dans les transports publics, vous apportez votre contribution à la sécurité, à la paix et à l'ordre. - En étroite collaboration avec nos organisations partenaires, vous assumerez la responsabilité du réseau de sécurité et contribuerez à ce que nos clients se sentent bien protégés et en sécurité à tout moment. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Techniker:in Sicherungsanlagen Innenbereich lokalisierst und behebst du selbständig Störungen an unseren komplexen Anlagen wie Stellwerken und Bahnübergängen. Du bist derjenige, der unsere Kunden im Nu wieder auf die Gleise bringt! Wochenweise übernimmst du den Pikettdienst – und dafür gibt's natürlich eine faire Entschädigung. Ausserdem bist du zuständig für den Unterhalt, den Bau und von Stellwerk- und Leittechnikanlagen. Kontrolliere mit einem eingespielten Team nicht nur Anlagen, sondern den reibungslosen Ablauf des grössten Transportunternehmens der Schweiz.
Wir suchen an diesen Standorten der Deutschschweiz Unterstützung: Luzern, Spreitenbach und Sargans.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche die freien Schwimmbäder und Fitnesscenter geniessen und deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet. Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du führst selbständig Bau- und Unterhaltstätigkeiten an den Stellwerk-Innenanlagen und teilweise an den Aussenanlagen aus.
- Du unterstützt aktiv die Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit der Bahninfrastrukturanlagen wirtschaftlich zu gewährleisten.
- Während dem Pikettdienst behebst du Störungen an den komplexen Anlagen, um deren Verfügbarkeit sicherzustellen.
- Abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekt arbeitest du gelegentlich in der Nacht und selten an Wochenenden.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist eine technisch affine Persönlichkeit mit einer selbständigen und flexiblen Arbeitsweise.
- Ein uneingeschränktes Hör- und Sehvermögen wird vorausgesetzt, um bei Einsätzen im Gleisbereich wichtige akustische und visuelle Signale erkennen zu können.
- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung EFZ (Automatiker:in, Elektroinstallateur:in oder vergleichbare Berufe). Idealerweise wohnst du in der Nähe der jeweiligen Niederlassung, da die Bereitschaft, wochenweise Pikettdienst zu leisten, Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist.
- Bereitschaft zur Absolvierung der 2-jährigen berufsbegleitenden internen Ausbildung zur Techniker:in Sicherungsanlagen Innenbereich. Die SBB übernimmt dafür vollständig Zeit und Kosten.
- Gültiger Führerausweis der Kategorie B sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens B2-Niveau werden vorausgesetzt.

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau E, Regionalzulage Stufe 2. Technician:in Safety Systems Interior, Electrical Installer:in, Automatic Engineer:in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Technician:in Safety Systems Interior, Electrical Installer:in, Automatic Engineer:in German-speaking Switzerland, as of now or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to that. As a technician: Indoor safety systems, you will independently locate and correct disturbances at our complex systems such as signal boxes and level crossings. You are the one who brings our customers back on track in an instant! Weekly you take over the Picettdienst – and of course there is a fair compensation. In addition, you are responsible for the maintenance, construction and of signalling and control systems. With a well-established team, check not only plants, but the smooth running of Switzerland’s largest transport company. We are looking for support at these locations of German-speaking Switzerland: Lucerne, Brugg, Spreitenbach and Sargans. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even in the case of irregular working hours. You can enjoy the free swimming pools and fitness centers during the week and make your free time more flexible. Night and weekend work is paid for with us. You will also receive time allowances. This means you have more free time than others without night and weekend assignments. Our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - can be found on our website under " Benefits". Further insights into the profession as a security system technician: inside you can get at the professional worlds of SBB or directly here: Technician: inside security systems | SBB You can make a difference. - You independently carry out construction and maintenance activities on the signal box interiors and partly on the exteriors. - You actively support the economical guarantee of the reliability, availability and safety of railway infrastructure facilities. During the Picetting Service, you will repair disruptions to the complex facilities to ensure their availability. - Depending on the project, you work occasionally at night and rarely on weekends. You bring that with you. - You are a technically affine personality with an independent and flexible way of working. - Unrestricted hearing and vision is required in order to be able to detect important acoustic and visual signals during track operations. - You have completed basic electrotechnical training EFZ (automatic: in, electrical installer: in or comparable professions). Ideally, you live close to the respective branch, as the willingness to provide weekly piquetting service is a prerequisite for this job. - Readiness to complete the 2-year internal training for technicians: in indoor safety systems. SBB assumes full time and costs for this. - Valid driving licence of category B as well as very good knowledge of German in words and writing at at least B2 level are required. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This job is in Requirement Level E, Regional Allowance Level 2. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. This starts with your application. ## Continue like this. × At the latest 10 working days after receipt of the application, you will receive an initial feedback from us. Final decision 5 - 6 weeks after receiving the application Application Final decision 5 - 6 weeks after receiving the application Still questions? For the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #simplyYou FAQ to apply For Job ID 102012 Sidney Aeschbacher, Regional Representative Pool Recruitment Center Telephone 051 285 19 90 Thomas Werle, Regional Representative Pool Recruitment East Telephone 051 285 24 43 Applications by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered. For this position, we do not accept dossiers from recruiters. ##
• We offer that. Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to reconciling your professional life with your private life. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Learn More Learn More Career and Development Career and Development Learn More We promote our employees according to their personal needs and ambitions. Technicien:en systèmes de sécurité à l'intérieur, électricien:en, technicien en automatisation:en Suisse alémanique, dès maintenant ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. En tant que technicien en systèmes de sécurité intérieure, vous localiserez et réparerez de manière autonome les défauts de nos systèmes complexes tels que les postes de signalisation et les passages à niveau. Vous êtes celui qui remettra nos clients sur la bonne voie en un rien de temps ! Vous assumez le service de garde sur une base hebdomadaire - et bien sûr, vous recevez une rémunération équitable en échange. Vous êtes également responsable de la maintenance, de la construction et des systèmes de signalisation et de technologie de contrôle. Avec une équipe bien rodée, vous contrôlez non seulement les systèmes, mais aussi le bon fonctionnement de la plus grande entreprise de transport de Suisse. Nous recherchons du soutien sur ces sites de Suisse alémanique : Lucerne, Brugg, Spreitenbach et Sargans. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Vous pouvez profiter des piscines et des centres de remise en forme gratuits pendant la semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Le travail de nuit et de week-end est rémunéré en supplément. Vous recevrez également des allocations de temps. Cela signifie que vous avez plus de temps libre que les autres sans devoirs de nuit et de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez obtenir de plus amples informations sur le métier de technicien en sécurité intérieure dans les mondes professionnels des CFF ou directement ici: Technicien en sécurité intérieure | CFF Vous pouvez le faire. - Vous réalisez en toute autonomie les activités de construction et de maintenance sur les systèmes de postes de signalisation intérieurs et en partie sur les systèmes extérieurs. - Vous soutenez activement la garantie économique de la fiabilité, de la disponibilité et de la sécurité des systèmes d'infrastructure ferroviaire. - Lors du service d'astreinte, vous dépannez des systèmes complexes pour assurer leur disponibilité. - Selon le projet en question, vous travaillerez occasionnellement la nuit et rarement le week-end. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes une personnalité techniquement compétente avec une manière de travailler indépendante et flexible. - Une audition et une vision sans restriction sont nécessaires pour pouvoir reconnaître les signaux acoustiques et visuels importants lors des opérations dans la zone de la piste. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base en électrotechnique (EFZ) (automaticien, électricien ou professions assimilées). Les CFF prennent à leur charge l'intégralité du temps et des coûts. - Un permis de conduire valide de catégorie B et de très bonnes compétences en allemand écrit et parlé au moins de niveau B2 sont requis. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence E, niveau d'allocation régionale 2. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Installatore di linee di catenaria, fabbro, meccanico, elettricista di rete, installatore elettrico nella Svizzera tedesca, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di tecnico della catenaria, costruisci e mantieni l'alimentazione elettrica di trazione e assicuri la tensione nei treni. Ti aspettano compiti entusiasmanti in un team numeroso e motivato, cambiamenti di sede e un lavoro tecnico con vera responsabilità.
• Cerchiamo sostegno in queste località della Svizzera tedesca: Zurigo, Brugg, Ostermundigen, Rapperswil e Winterthur. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Ma puoi goderti le piscine vuote durante la settimana e organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Beneficerai anche di interessanti bonus di tempo. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. descriptionByLocale.en: Catenary line fitter, locksmith, mechanic, network electrician, electrician 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Catenary line fitter, locksmith, mechanic, network electrician, electrical installer in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a catenary line technician, you build and maintain the traction power supply and ensure voltage in the trains. Exciting tasks await you in a great and motivated team, changing locations and a technical job with real responsibility. We are looking for support in these locations in German-speaking Switzerland: Zurich, Brugg, Ostermundigen, Rapperswil and Winterthur. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy empty swimming pools during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You also benefit from attractive time bonuses. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can get further insights into the job as a transport route builder / track builder at the SBB's professional world or directly here: Network electrician in catenary | SBB You can do that. - As a contact line technician, you and your team carry out all maintenance, renewal work and troubleshooting on contact line systems. - You carry out switching work and issue switching orders. You also carry out the necessary grounding work independently. - Thanks to your specialist knowledge and the associated skills, you will lead construction trains, operate work baskets and cranes and have the appropriate training for this. - We assume that you are willing to work at irregular hours, especially at night and sometimes on weekends. This is what you bring with you. - You are a team player, skilled in craftsmanship, with a strong awareness of safety and always enjoy continuing your education. - Ideally, experience would be in catenary, overhead line or metal construction. - We require proof of skills from the electrical industry, metal construction or construction industry and an impeccable reputation. - You have the willingness to be trained as a head of safety or security manager according to RT20100 and as a train driver. - To succeed in this role, you must communicate fluently in German. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisire nuove competenze che vi arricchiranno e faranno progredire professionalmente. • Cerchiamo supporto in diverse località della Svizzera tedesca. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Puoi allenarti nel centro fitness durante la settimana, goderti il ​​sole in piscina, fare shopping senza fare la fila: rendi semplicemente più flessibile il tuo tempo libero. Forniamo inoltre un compenso finanziario aggiuntivo per il lavoro di guardia, notturno e nei fine settimana. Riceverai anche indennità di tempo. Ciò significa che puoi compensare queste indennità di tempo con tempo libero. Non esageri quando dici che senza di te la Svizzera è ferma, perché il tuo impegno e il tuo lavoro contribuiscono in modo significativo al buon funzionamento delle ferrovie. - Come giocatore di squadra, aiuterai a individuare e risolvere rapidamente i guasti sul sistema ferroviario. Addetto alle manovre laterali: a Spreitenbach, d'ora in poi o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce ogni anno di 15.000 viaggi di camion il carico sulle strade e ogni anno di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 l'impatto sull'ambiente. Aiuterai a garantire che i nostri clienti siano serviti in modo affidabile e puntuale. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro entusiasmante, in cui tu e i tuoi compagni di squadra farete avanzare la Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, per questo motivo durante la tua formazione riceverai la retribuzione intera. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 6 franchi l'ora per il lavoro notturno. Per i turni notturni riceverai anche un'indennità compresa tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi svilupparti ulteriormente internamente, ad esempio completando la formazione per diventare specialista di manovra o macchinista di manovra. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry for shunting employees: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry shunting employee: in Spreitenbach, from now on or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck journeys every day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. You will help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time. An exciting working environment awaits you, in which you and your teammates will move Switzerland forward. Attractive working conditions are important to us, which is why you will receive full wages during your training. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 6 francs per hour for night work. For night shifts you will also receive a time allowance of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can develop further internally, for example by completing training to become a shunting specialist or shunting train driver. You can move that. - You carry out shunting movements by moving, assembling and dismantling freight trains and wagons. - Your daily tasks include coupling and uncoupling locomotives and freight cars as well as carrying out brake tests. - You prepare freight trains for travel and ensure that parked vehicles in the track area are secured. - In your everyday work, you use various tools such as radios and tablets to complete your tasks efficiently. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - Because of your safety awareness, it is natural for you to work according to regulations. - You are physically fit for this demanding 24-hour shift work and enjoy working outside in any weather. - Ideally, you have completed basic training or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. - You have good oral German skills (at least level B1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level C, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. - Zu deinen täglichen Aufgaben zählt das Kuppeln und Entkuppeln von Lokomotiven und Güterwagen sowie das Durchführen von Bremsproben.
- Du bereitest Güterzüge für die Fahrt vor und sorgst dafür, dass abgestellte Fahrzeuge im Gleisbereich gesichert sind.
- Im Arbeitsalltag nutzt du verschiedene Hilfsmittel wie Funkgeräte und Tablets, um deine Aufgaben effizient zu erledigen.

- Idealerweise hast du eine Grundbildung abgeschlossen oder bringst bereits Berufserfahrungen im handwerklichen, logistischen oder vergleichbaren Bereich mit.

Per l'inizio dell'apprendistato il 1 agosto 2026, stiamo cercando un Responsabile CIE per gli agenti di trasporto ferroviario CFC (15 giorni di corsi nei primi due anni di apprendistato) ## Cosa puoi realizzare: - Qualificazione degli apprendisti agenti di trasporto ferroviario CFC nell'ambito dei CIE e loro preparazione per l'impegno nell'apprendistato - Pianificazione individuale della preparazione e monitoraggio degli apprendistati CIE (ad es. documentazione delle prestazioni degli apprendisti nell'ambito dei controlli delle competenze) - Sviluppo di competenze metodologiche e sociali nonché supporto agli apprendisti a seconda della situazione - Utilizzo attivo della propria esperienza professionale nel campo dei trasporti pubblici (TP) ## Cosa porti: - Tirocinio completato come conducente di veicoli a motore cat. A40 e minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del TP - Completamento del certificato FSEA o formazione didattica equivalente, o disponibilità a seguire tale formazione. - Spirito di iniziativa e personalità comunicativa, avendo già esperienza come formatore o in altra attività legata alla formazione - Piacere nel lavorare con i giovani - Competenze metodologiche e didattiche, nonché un atteggiamento sicuro e professionale ## Cosa ti aspetta: Un'attività varia ed impegnativa, con un certo margine di manovra, in un ambiente dinamico. Abbiamo suscitato il tuo interesse? Per qualsiasi ulteriore informazione non esitate a contattare Simon Eng, responsabile della formazione. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura tramite il nostro strumento di candidatura.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Responsible for CIE for rail transport agents CFC | login Berufsbildung - - - - - - - - Your position in the world of mobility As a training partner of the SBB, BLS, RhB, the Public Transport Union (UTP) and more than 80 other companies active in or close to the field of mobility, login professional training SA organizes professional apprenticeships, internships and further training in line with the market for around 2100 trainees in more than 35 different professions. On mandate from UTP, login organizes inter-company courses (CIE) for the apprenticeship of CFC rail transport agents. For the start of the apprenticeship on August 1, 2026, we are looking for a CIE Manager for CFC rail transport agents (15 days of courses during the first two years of apprenticeship) ## What you can make happen: - Qualification of CFC rail transport agent apprentices within the framework of the CIEs as well as their preparation for their engagement on the apprenticeship - Individual planning of the preparation and monitoring of the apprenticeships CIE (e.g. documentation of apprentices' performance in the context of skills checks) - Development of methodological and social skills as well as support for apprentices depending on the situation - Active use of own professional experience in the field of public transport (TP) ##
• What you bring: - Completed apprenticeship as a driver of motor vehicles cat. A40 and minimum 5 years of professional experience in the field of TP - Completion of the FSEA certificate or equivalent didactic training, or willingness to follow such training. - Spirit of initiative and communicative personality, already having experience as a trainer or in another activity linked to training - Pleasure in working with young people - Methodological and didactic skills, as well as a confident and professional attitude ## What awaits you: A varied and demanding activity, with a certain margin of maneuver, in a dynamic environment. Have we piqued your interest? For any further information, do not hesitate to contact Simon Eng, training manager. We look forward to receiving your application via our application tool.

Ton poste dans le monde de la mobilité
En tant que partenaire de formation des CFF, du BLS, des RhB, de l'Union des transports publics (UTP) et de plus de 80 autres entreprises actives dans le domaine de la mobilité ou proches de celles-ci, login formation professionnelle SA organise des apprentissages professionnels, des stages et des formations complémentaires en phase avec le marché pour environ 2100 personnes en formation dans plus de 35 professions différentes.
Sur mandat de l'UTP, login organise les cours interentreprises (CIE) de l'apprentissage des agent·e·s de transport ferroviaire CFC. Pour le début de l'apprentissage 1er août 2026 , nous recherchons un·e
Responsable des CIE pour les agent·e·s de transport ferroviaire CFC
(15 jours de cours pendant les deux premières années d'apprentissage)

## Ce que tu peux faire bouger :
- Qualification des apprenti·e·s agent·e·s de transport ferroviaire CFC dans le cadre des CIE ainsi que leur préparation en vue de leur engagement sur la place d'apprentissage
- Planification individuelle de la préparation et du suivi des CIE (p. ex. documentation des performances des apprenti·e·s dans le cadre des contrôles de compétences)
- Développement des compétences méthodologiques et sociales ainsi que l'accompagnement des apprenti·e·s en fonction de la situation
- Mise à profit active de sa propre expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des transports publics (TP)

- Apprentissage achevé de conducteur·trice de véhicules moteurs cat. A40 et minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des TP
- Achèvement du certificat FSEA ou d'une formation didactique équivalente, ou disposition à suivre une telle formation.
- Esprit d'initiative et personnalité communicative , disposant déjà d'une expérience en tant que formateur·trice ou dans une autre activité liée à la formation

Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Rangierspezialist:in Infrastruktur
Winterthur, 01.03.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und dir gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.
Als Bauzugbegleiter:in kannst du einen Grundstein legen für eine weitere Karriere als Lokführer:in Bauzüge.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits und mehr Infos zum Beruf findest du hier
Das kannst du bewegen.
- In dieser abwechslungsreichen Position trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Bauzüge pünktlich abfahrbereit sind und sicherst damit die Eisenbahnbaulogistik.
- Als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du die betriebliche und technische Zuguntersuchung und unterstützt den/die Lokführer:in bei sicheren Zugfahrten von A nach B.
- Du begleitest dabei sowohl Rangier- als auch Zugfahrten.
- Nebst deiner Tätigkeit als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du auf der Baustelle eine Sicherheitsfunktion oder unterstützt deine Kollegen:innen bei Arbeiten im Gleisbereich.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb bist du körperlich und psychisch belastbar und arbeitest gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Du hast eine Grundbildung abgeschlossen und verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre. Zudem bringst du bereits Berufserfahrungen im handwerklichen, logistischen oder vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
- Die Weiterbildungen zum Bauzugbegleiter:in (Kat. Ai), Sicherheitswärter:in und oder Sicherheitschef:in hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Bei deiner täglichen Arbeit bedienst du unter anderem ein Tablet. Der Umgang mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln bereitet dir keine Mühe.
- In Deutsch bist du fliessend in Wort und Schrift.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche).

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

descriptionByLocale.it: Specialista della manovra: nelle infrastrutture 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Specialista della manovra: nell'infrastruttura Winterthur, 1 marzo 2026 o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. In qualità di addetto ai treni edili puoi gettare le basi per un'ulteriore carriera come macchinista dei treni edili. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi fare la differenza. - In questa posizione diversificata contribuirai a garantire che i nostri treni da cantiere siano pronti a partire in orario e quindi a garantire la logistica della costruzione ferroviaria. - In qualità di addetto ai treni di cantiere, ti occupi delle ispezioni operative e tecniche dei treni e assisti il ​​macchinista nei viaggi in treno sicuri da A a B. - Accompagni sia le manovre che i viaggi in treno. - Oltre al tuo lavoro come addetto ai treni di costruzione, assumi un ruolo di sicurezza in cantiere o assisti i tuoi colleghi quando lavorano nell'area dei binari. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente per questo lavoro impegnativo su turni di 24 ore e ti piace lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Hai completato la formazione di base e idealmente hai completato un apprendistato professionale. Hai anche esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in settori comparabili. - Hai completato con successo la formazione continua per diventare addetto ai treni edili (Cat. Ai), guardia di sicurezza e/o capo della sicurezza. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano usi, tra le altre cose, un tablet. Non devi preoccuparti di utilizzare moderne attrezzature da lavoro. - Parli correntemente il tedesco parlato e scritto. - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde). ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione definitiva entro un mese dal ricevimento della domanda Domanda Decisione definitiva entro un mese dal ricevimento della domanda Domande? Informazioni sul processo di candidatura Supporto Recruiting FFS Telefono + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu Domande frequenti sulla candidatura Alla posizione Job ID 101977 Dirk Polzin, team leader Telefono +41 79 172 36 89 Purtroppo non è possibile prendere in considerazione candidature via e-mail. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Shunting specialist: in infrastructure 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting specialist: in infrastructure Winterthur, March 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. As a construction train attendant, you can lay the foundation for a further career as a construction train driver. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can make a difference. - In this varied position, you will help ensure that our construction trains are ready to leave on time and thus ensure railway construction logistics. - As a construction train attendant, you take on operational and technical train inspections and support the locomotive driver in safe train journeys from A to B. - You accompany both shunting and train journeys. - In addition to your work as a construction train attendant, you take on a safety role on the construction site or support your colleagues when working in the track area. This is what you bring with you. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work in 24-hour shifts and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training and ideally have completed a vocational apprenticeship. You also have professional experience in crafts, logistics or comparable areas. - You have successfully completed the further training to become a construction train attendant (Cat. Ai), security guard and or head of security. - In your daily work you use, among other things, a tablet. You don't have to worry about using modern work equipment. - You are fluent in spoken and written German. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 101977 Dirk Polzin, team leader Telephone +41 79 172 36 89 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. En tant qu'accompagnateur de train de construction, vous pouvez jeter les bases d'une future carrière de conducteur de train de construction. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels qu'une AG gratuite, des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages et vous pouvez trouver plus d'informations sur le poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes résilient physiquement et mentalement pour ce travail exigeant en quarts de 24 heures et aimez travailler dehors par tous les temps. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base et idéalement effectué un apprentissage professionnel. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Es erwartet dich eine 14-monatige bezahlte Teilzeitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin bzw. zum Zugverkehrsleiter. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung trägst du aus der Betriebszentrale am Zürich Flughafen tatkräftig dazu bei, dass 9000 Reise- und 2000 Güterzüge täglich pünktlich und sicher ihr Ziel erreichen. Bereits während der Ausbildung liegt uns deine Work-Life-Balance am Herzen. Deshalb kannst du deine Praxistage für die Ausbildungszeit im 60% Pensum frei wählen und die restlichen Tage somit gut vorzeitig für deine Life-Balance einplanen.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%. Das bedeutet, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

- Du behältst den Überblick über das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz und lenkst die darauf verkehrenden Züge ökologisch.
- Dazu kommunizierst du mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokführerinnen und Lokführern sowie Leitstellen und verantwortest die Information für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden an Bahnhöfen.
- Wenn eine Störung auftritt, reagierst du sicherheitsorientiert und schnell, um den Normalbetrieb wiederherzustellen.
- In deiner täglichen Arbeit greifst du auf verschiedenste Systeme zurück. Entsprechend basiert deine Arbeit auf dem Vertrauen in das Zusammenspiel zwischen Mensch und Technik.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Berufsinformationsveranstaltung .

Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale (formazione a tempo parziale) Aeroporto di Zurigo, 1 settembre 2026, 60% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Puoi aspettarti 14 mesi di formazione part-time retribuita per diventare responsabile del traffico ferroviario. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, contribuirai attivamente dalla centrale operativa dell'aeroporto di Zurigo a garantire che ogni giorno 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino a destinazione in tempo e in sicurezza. Il tuo equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata è importante per noi durante la tua formazione. Ecco perché puoi scegliere liberamente i tuoi giorni pratici per il periodo di formazione con un carico di lavoro del 60% e pianificare con largo anticipo i giorni rimanenti per il tuo equilibrio di vita. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Se lavori di notte riceverai anche un'indennità dal 10 al 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario, svolgi un ruolo importante nel buon funzionamento del traffico ferroviario e hai una grande influenza sulla soddisfazione dei clienti. - Tieni traccia della rete di collegamenti che ti è stata assegnata e gestisci i treni che la percorrono in modo ecologico. - Comunicherai con i compagni di squadra, i macchinisti e i centri di controllo e sarai responsabile di fornire informazioni ai nostri clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie. - Se si verifica un'interruzione, reagire in modo sicuro e rapido per ripristinare il normale funzionamento. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano utilizzi un'ampia varietà di sistemi. Di conseguenza, il tuo lavoro si basa sulla fiducia nell’interazione tra persone e tecnologia. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo sulla carriera. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Il tuo pensiero in rete e il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente ti aiutano a reagire rapidamente e correttamente alle interruzioni. - Aver completato un tirocinio professionale di 3 anni o un diploma di scuola superiore. - Parli fluentemente la lingua del luogo di formazione, sia verbalmente che per iscritto (livello C2) e possibilmente conosci una seconda lingua nazionale (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde). - Durante la procedura di richiesta vi chiederemo di fornire un estratto aggiornato del vostro registro penale e delle esecuzioni (non più vecchio di 3 mesi). Puoi ordinare i documenti quando ci inviti a incontrarti di persona. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) Zurich Airport, September 1st, 2026, 60% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You can expect 14 months of paid part-time training to become a train traffic manager. After successfully completing your final exam, you will actively contribute from the operations center at Zurich Airport to ensuring that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Your work-life balance is important to us during your training. That's why you can freely choose your practical days for the training period with a 60% workload and plan the remaining days well in advance for your life balance. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. If you work at night, you will also receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - As a train traffic manager, you play an important role in the smooth running of rail traffic and have a major influence on customer satisfaction. - You keep track of the route network assigned to you and manage the trains running on it ecologically. - You will communicate with teammates, train drivers and control centers and be responsible for providing information to our customers at train stations. - If a disruption occurs, you react safety-oriented and quickly to restore normal operation. - In your daily work you use a wide variety of systems. Accordingly, your work is based on trust in the interaction between people and technology. Find out more about the career profile at the next career information event. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work 24-hour shifts. - Your networked thinking and your independent way of working help you to react quickly and correctly to disruptions. - You have completed a 3-year vocational apprenticeship or high school diploma. - You are fluent in the language of the training location, both verbally and in writing (level C2) and ideally have knowledge of a second national language (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). Vous pouvez vous attendre à 14 mois de formation rémunérée à temps partiel pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous contribuerez activement, depuis le centre opérationnel de l'aéroport de Zurich, à ce que 9 000 trains de passagers et 2 000 trains de marchandises atteignent chaque jour leur destination à temps et en toute sécurité. C'est pourquoi vous pouvez choisir librement vos journées pratiques pour le stage avec une charge de travail de 60% et planifier les jours restants bien à l'avance pour votre équilibre de vie. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Si vous travaillez de nuit, vous bénéficierez également d'une indemnité horaire de 10 à 30 %. Par conséquent, votre travail est basé sur la confiance dans l’interaction entre les personnes et la technologie. Apprenez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information sur les carrières. Il tuo equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata è importante per noi durante la tua formazione. Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) Olten, September 1st, 2026, 60% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You can expect 14 months of paid part-time training to become a train traffic manager. After successfully completing the final exam, you will actively contribute from the operations center in Olten to ensuring that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Your work-life balance is important to us during your training. That's why you can freely choose your practical days for the training period with a 60% workload and plan the remaining days well in advance for your life balance. Vous pouvez vous attendre à 14 mois de formation rémunérée à temps partiel pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire. Après avoir réussi l'examen final, vous contribuerez activement, depuis le centre opérationnel d'Olten, à ce que 9 000 trains de voyageurs et 2 000 trains de marchandises atteignent chaque jour leur destination à temps et en toute sécurité. Circa 14'000 collaboratori del trasporto passeggeri garantiscono che gli oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti delle FFS che trasportiamo ogni giorno abbiano un facile accesso ai trasporti pubblici e viaggino da A a B in modo sicuro e puntuale. In quanto gruppo professionale centrale, il personale di manovra fornisce un contributo fondamentale a questo scopo. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, nel quale ti muoverai alle FFS insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, oltre a una formazione varia e retribuita. Hai anche diverse opportunità di formazione interna. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni verranno applicati supplementi orari compresi tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Possibili iniziazioni formative nel 2026/2027: - 1 giugno 2026 - 1 agosto 2026 - 1 ottobre 2026 - 1 gennaio 2027 - 1 marzo 2027 - 1 maggio 2027 - 1 giugno 2027 - 1 agosto 2027 - 1 ottobre 2027 Puoi muoversi. - Prepari i treni passeggeri per il loro viaggio e li sposti al punto di partenza corretto dentro e intorno alla stazione (fino a un massimo di 40 km/h). - Metti insieme i treni, separa i singoli vagoni e assicurati che tutto sia al posto giusto. - Prepari il treno per la partenza, controlli le funzioni più importanti ed effettui i controlli dei freni. - Durante il tuo lavoro mantieni una visione d'insieme e ti assicuri che tutti i processi si svolgano in modo sicuro e senza intoppi. - Puoi riparare tu stesso i problemi minori o segnalarli all'ufficio competente.
